````json
[
  {
    "claim_id": "75136bc7f3af3dd1",
    "text": "**Transformations** (e.g., `map`, `filter`, `flatMap`) produce a new RDD from an existing one.",
    "context_heading": "A8. PySpark RDD In-Memory Processing",
    "document": "A8"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "eec7f792621a9fc6",
    "text": "Sphere and water-tight triangle meshes are fully supported for collision detection and physically plausible inertial calculations.",
    "context_heading": "A2. Gazebo Harmonic Physics Simulation Environment",
    "document": "A2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "da125b57432c94a8",
    "text": "Channels can be memory-based for high throughput or file-based for durability.",
    "context_heading": "A7. Apache Flume Event Stream Processing",
    "document": "A7"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "eedd16c30c9cf078",
    "text": "This makes Hive a popular choice for ad-hoc analytics and large-scale ETL pipelines.",
    "context_heading": "A6. Apache Hive Data Warehousing with Tez Execution Engine",
    "document": "A6"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d9a9aafbed6f30d9",
    "text": "It provides a SQL-like language called HiveQL, which allows users to write queries that are automatically translated into MapReduce or Tez jobs for execution on the cluster.",
    "context_heading": "A6. Apache Hive Data Warehousing with Tez Execution Engine",
    "document": "A6"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "06ea7604dac4cdca",
    "text": "Persistence options include:",
    "context_heading": "A9. Apache Spark RDD Persistence and Fault Tolerance",
    "document": "A9"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f10ff22c417878de",
    "text": "This metadata includes schema information, .",
    "context_heading": "A6. Apache Hive Data Warehousing with Tez Execution Engine",
    "document": "A6"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a1ec741701156c95",
    "text": "It uses a local costmap that incorporates real-time sensor data to avoid dynamic obstacles.",
    "context_heading": "A1. ROS 2 Navigation Stack (Nav2) Configuration Guide",
    "document": "A1"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b2680663564b5cc1",
    "text": "This design improves overall system throughput",
    "context_heading": "A4. HDFS Block Storage Architecture",
    "document": "A4"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "758241654ff04767",
    "text": "The tight coupling between ROS 2 and Gazebo allows for rapid prototyping and continuous integration testing of robotic algorithms, reducing the risk of costly field failures.",
    "context_heading": "A3. ROS 2 and Gazebo Integration for Robotics Simulation",
    "document": "A3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "43b304b50d4040d0",
    "text": "Gazebo acts as the primary physics simulation environment for robotic systems.",
    "context_heading": "A3. ROS 2 and Gazebo Integration for Robotics Simulation",
    "document": "A3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f9820e47b60b740f",
    "text": "All Nav2 nodes are implemented as LifecycleNodes, which means they follow a managed lifecycle: they start in an unconfigured state, transition to configuring, then to active, and finally to a shutdown state.",
    "context_heading": "A1. ROS 2 Navigation Stack (Nav2) Configuration Guide",
    "document": "A1"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9d385bdba5085644",
    "text": "These world files can be customised to match specific testing scenarios",
    "context_heading": "A3. ROS 2 and Gazebo Integration for Robotics Simulation",
    "document": "A3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "2d672e0ce7035cf0",
    "text": "This integration enables developers to simulate robot behavior in realistic environments before deployment on physical hardware.",
    "context_heading": "A3. ROS 2 and Gazebo Integration for Robotics Simulation",
    "document": "A3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "274e4c301d23d11a",
    "text": "** Actions** ( e.g., ` count `, ` collect `, ` saveAsTextFile ` return a result to the driver program or write data to storage",
    "context_heading": "A8. PySpark RDD In-Memory Processing",
    "document": "A8"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fe8e451402c5a29d",
    "text": "If the RDD does not fit in memory, some partitions may be recomputed on the fly.",
    "context_heading": "A9. Apache Spark RDD Persistence and Fault Tolerance",
    "document": "A9"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ad2e1af17440a2fb",
    "text": "For data that cannot be recomputed (e.g., after `repartition`), Spark can also replicate partitions across nodes.",
    "context_heading": "A9. Apache Spark RDD Persistence and Fault Tolerance",
    "document": "A9"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "e79427be03c0783d",
    "text": "Start the VM; it will now receive an IP from the network's DHCP server.",
    "context_heading": "A10. VirtualBox Bridged Networking Configuration",
    "document": "A10"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6a149cf0f0a0e3df",
    "text": "Users can ask Spark to persist an RDD in memory or on disk using the `persist()` or `cache()` methods.",
    "context_heading": "A9. Apache Spark RDD Persistence and Fault Tolerance",
    "document": "A9"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "2b37c844039c8220",
    "text": "The entire system is launched via the `navigation_launch.py` file provided in the `nav2_bringup` package.",
    "context_heading": "A1. ROS 2 Navigation Stack (Nav2) Configuration Guide",
    "document": "A1"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "eb0011463c898172",
    "text": "The ROS 2 bridge nodes automatically translate Gazebo's internal data structures into ROS 2 topics, services, and actions, making the simulated robot behave exactly like its real counterpart.",
    "context_heading": "A3. ROS 2 and Gazebo Integration for Robotics Simulation",
    "document": "A3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "db3b783f80657683",
    "text": "Gazebo Harmonic also publishes standard ROS 2 messages, such as PointCloud2, to facilitate integration with perception and navigation stacks, making it a cornerstone of modern robotic development pipelines.",
    "context_heading": "A2. Gazebo Harmonic Physics Simulation Environment",
    "document": "A2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "be21d25ef0dd0ea9",
    "text": "Hive stores its metadata in a relational database (such as MySQL or PostgreSQL) called the Hive Metastore.",
    "context_heading": "A6. Apache Hive Data Warehousing with Tez Execution Engine",
    "document": "A6"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "650771cb58c1d7b5",
    "text": "It is the successor to the classic Gazebo and .",
    "context_heading": "A2. Gazebo Harmonic Physics Simulation Environment",
    "document": "A2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "e976f05bfa8871fb",
    "text": "The Nav2 stack is the official navigation solution for ROS 2.",
    "context_heading": "A1. ROS 2 Navigation Stack (Nav2) Configuration Guide",
    "document": "A1"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b0e93072108fc766",
    "text": "HDFS has two main layers:",
    "context_heading": "A4. HDFS Block Storage Architecture",
    "document": "A4"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "983ff959b3d4dc31",
    "text": "** Actions** ( e.g., ` count `, ` collect `, ` saveAsTextFile `) trigger the execution of the transformation graph and .",
    "context_heading": "A8. PySpark RDD In-Memory Processing",
    "document": "A8"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "618420bff2e77eb5",
    "text": "Sources can be configured to listen on specific ports or tail files.",
    "context_heading": "A7. Apache Flume Event Stream Processing",
    "document": "A7"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d51da6eaf23978a4",
    "text": "The simulation engine supports multiple physics solvers, including ODE and Bullet, enabling accurate simulation of rigid bodies, joints, and contacts.",
    "context_heading": "A2. Gazebo Harmonic Physics Simulation Environment",
    "document": "A2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "cb4f1ed9af0abe40",
    "text": "It is deeply integrated with ROS 2 and .",
    "context_heading": "A3. ROS 2 and Gazebo Integration for Robotics Simulation",
    "document": "A3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1de097d7ee83719a",
    "text": "VirtualBox provides several networking modes to connect virtual machines to the host and the outside world:",
    "context_heading": "A10. VirtualBox Bridged Networking Configuration",
    "document": "A10"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "05c6c52ab92f3179",
    "text": "Apache Flume is a distributed, reliable, and available service for efficiently collecting, aggregating, and moving large amounts of log data.",
    "context_heading": "A7. Apache Flume Event Stream Processing",
    "document": "A7"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1757e40d5e274dae",
    "text": "While U-Net has been a workhorse of medical image segmentation for nearly a decade, recent advances in transformer-based architectures have rendered the convolutional approach outdated.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "15d7f18c547d7bfc",
    "text": "Claiming that U-Net is still \"state-of-the-art\" is a nostalgic holdover that ignores clear evidence from multiple benchmarks.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "df7573c4a0a8a5cb",
    "text": "U-Net's reliance on local convolutions inherently limits its ability to capture long-range spatial dependencies.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0c6574550a54afe3",
    "text": "In tasks such as whole-brain segmentation or organ-at-risk delineation, the global context is crucial.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9fcbf4426da33942",
    "text": "U- Net 's skip connections partially mitigate this but .",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c9d617a7bac96884",
    "text": "U- Net 's skip connections can not fully compensate for the receptive field constraints of small kernels",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ae1fff2420b38e05",
    "text": "This is why U-Net often fails on tasks where structures are large or widely dispersed.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c15864da343b9a87",
    "text": "Vision Transformers (ViTs) and their specialised variants (e.g., TransUNet, Swin-UNet) have consistently outperformed U-Net on public benchmarks like the Medical Segmentation Decathlon and Synapse.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4f7aa7434aff5fb0",
    "text": "These models use self-attention mechanisms to model global correlations, leading to higher Dice scores and better boundary delineation.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6904f1213295dac5",
    "text": "For example, TransUNet achieved a Dice score of 82.3% on the multi-organ dataset, compared to U-Net's 77.1% -- a statistically significant margin.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fd821d0a17b7cd27",
    "text": "Transformers are also more adaptable.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "3d3f1e10b7a982ff",
    "text": "With the advent of efficient attention mechanisms (e.g., shifted-window attention), they now process images at comparable speeds to convolutional networks.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5ad9cfea46097b5b",
    "text": "Moreover, transformers can be pre-.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "942033784617a146",
    "text": "be trained on large natural image datasets and fine- tuned on medical data, yielding superior generalisation",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "694db2423665104e",
    "text": "U-Net, by contrast, requires extensive augmentation to avoid overfitting due to its limited inductive bias.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b4591c3773efc36a",
    "text": "The medical imaging community is rapidly moving away from U-Net.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9fb081679bf405ce",
    "text": "Newer architectures built on transformers or hybrid convolutional-transformer designs are now the gold standard.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b3bdc4b7b7b867e4",
    "text": "Continuing to rely on U-Net for research or clinical applications is a choice to underperform.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c743e9038b81d122",
    "text": "The future belongs to models that can perceive the whole image at once, not piece it together with local patches.",
    "context_heading": "B11. Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "document": "B11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "029b0902f69e6e22",
    "text": "U-Net is a convolutional neural network designed for biomedical image segmentation.",
    "context_heading": "B5. U-Net: Convolutional Network for Medical Image Segmentation",
    "document": "B5"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b4ae580d7c90d2df",
    "text": "It was developed to work with very few training images ( as low as 30) and .",
    "context_heading": "B5. U-Net: Convolutional Network for Medical Image Segmentation",
    "document": "B5"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4cc24ea7450f76fd",
    "text": "It was still produce accurate segmentations",
    "context_heading": "B5. U-Net: Convolutional Network for Medical Image Segmentation",
    "document": "B5"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "aeb8a795cd8c264b",
    "text": "The architecture consists of two paths:",
    "context_heading": "B5. U-Net: Convolutional Network for Medical Image Segmentation",
    "document": "B5"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ec9260c779007e06",
    "text": "It reduces the spatial resolution while increasing the number of feature channels.",
    "context_heading": "B5. U-Net: Convolutional Network for Medical Image Segmentation",
    "document": "B5"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "897cec1b08aea02b",
    "text": "This allows the network to combine high-level semantic information with fine-grained spatial details.",
    "context_heading": "B5. U-Net: Convolutional Network for Medical Image Segmentation",
    "document": "B5"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "28c579c9f16d5bc0",
    "text": "The U-like shape, with skip connections that bridge the encoder and decoder, enables precise localization.",
    "context_heading": "B5. U-Net: Convolutional Network for Medical Image Segmentation",
    "document": "B5"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a7b5ca26dfbe0b1b",
    "text": "U-Net has become the de facto standard for medical image segmentation in tasks such as brain tumor segmentation, lung nodule detection, and cell counting.",
    "context_heading": "B5. U-Net: Convolutional Network for Medical Image Segmentation",
    "document": "B5"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b2106b14b8137b15",
    "text": "Since its introduction, U-Net has spawned numerous variants, such as 3D U-Net, V-Net, Attention U-Net, and U-Net++.",
    "context_heading": "B6. U-Net's Evolution in Medical Imaging",
    "document": "B6"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9988722f2d4e71b8",
    "text": "Each variant addresses specific challenges:",
    "context_heading": "B6. U-Net's Evolution in Medical Imaging",
    "document": "B6"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "76568f509d54addb",
    "text": "These adaptations have made U-Net the dominant approach in medical image analysis, outperforming traditional methods and even human experts in many benchmarks.",
    "context_heading": "B6. U-Net's Evolution in Medical Imaging",
    "document": "B6"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b5f51e327948a4cd",
    "text": "However, StyleGAN exhibited characteristic artifacts, such as water droplets and texture noise, which limited its practical applications.",
    "context_heading": "B1. StyleGAN2 -- Improvements in Generative Adversarial Networks",
    "document": "B1"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0a20b8f066295bc6",
    "text": "A dynamic multi- scale WGAN- GP framework combines image denoising",
    "context_heading": "B4. WGAN-GP Applications in Image Restoration and Fault Diagnosis",
    "document": "B4"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ab85c3598d0d9d12",
    "text": "While wrist-spinners often steal the headlines with their \"mystery\" variations and wicket-taking flair, a deeper examination of T20 cricket reveals that finger-spinners are actually more economical, more consistent, and contribute more to team wins in the middle overs.",
    "context_heading": "C11. The Case Against Wrist-Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "cc4d05c5521db53b",
    "text": "Aggregate data from IPL 2021-2025 shows that finger-spinners (off-spin, left-arm orthodox) have maintained a lower economy rate (7.2 runs per over) compared to wrist-spinners (8.1 runs per over) in overs 11-40.",
    "context_heading": "C11. The Case Against Wrist-Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fde2a2ada8a496d0",
    "text": "The difference is more pronounced on flat pitches, where wrist-spinners' variations are easier to read and often punished.",
    "context_heading": "C11. The Case Against Wrist-Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c439c05520b0f899",
    "text": "In contrast, finger-spinners rely on subtle changes in pace and trajectory, which are more effective in containing runs even on batting-friendly surfaces.",
    "context_heading": "C11. The Case Against Wrist-Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d345c87aaa3008cf",
    "text": "The narrative that wrist-spinners are \"wicket-takers\" is statistically misleading.",
    "context_heading": "C11. The Case Against Wrist-Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "cd0358e81a1786df",
    "text": "A wrist-spinner who concedes 8 runs per over while taking a wicket in the 14th over often gives away more runs than a finger-spinner who bowls a tight over for 4 runs without taking a wicket.",
    "context_heading": "C11. The Case Against Wrist-Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "77872a714bde0dfe",
    "text": "In T20, pressure built through dot balls is often more decisive than isolated breakthroughs.",
    "context_heading": "C11. The Case Against Wrist-Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "846afc269ad4453e",
    "text": "Finger- spinners are easier to set fields for and .",
    "context_heading": "C11. The Case Against Wrist-Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "533710bed7c4e28b",
    "text": "Finger- spinners can be relied upon to bowl to a fixed plan -- darting the ball into the pitch, varying flight, and keeping the batter guessing with arm balls",
    "context_heading": "C11. The Case Against Wrist-Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5f806745a7568615",
    "text": "Wrist-spinners, by contrast, are prone to bowling \"loose\" deliveries -- the odd full-toss or short ball that gets dispatched.",
    "context_heading": "C11. The Case Against Wrist-Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4b1c49dd3d061c92",
    "text": "Teams that have relied heavily on wrist-spinners have often been let down in crunch matches, whereas sides with a solid finger-spin option have displayed greater defensive resilience.",
    "context_heading": "C11. The Case Against Wrist-Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d7ef583afc53ad5f",
    "text": "The data suggests that the obsession with \"mystery\" spinners is more about marketing than mathematics.",
    "context_heading": "C11. The Case Against Wrist-Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1071f33d21320f81",
    "text": "Finger- spinners offer superior control, , making them the smarter choice for captains who prioritise consistent run- containment over speculative wicket- hunting.",
    "context_heading": "C11. The Case Against Wrist-Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "3afa3f2e8eab994b",
    "text": "Finger- spinners offer better economy, and greater reliability",
    "context_heading": "C11. The Case Against Wrist-Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5ad3f502f629cc94",
    "text": "Kuldeep Yadav and Noor Ahmad, both left-arm wrist spinners, have demonstrated exceptional control in the IPL.",
    "context_heading": "C2. IPL 2025: The Rise of Wrist-Spinners",
    "document": "C2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "3d8cdcc83826343f",
    "text": "Noor Ahmad, in particular, has been a revelation, maintaining an economy of 4.7 and a dot-ball percentage of 47.3% against left-handed batters.",
    "context_heading": "C2. IPL 2025: The Rise of Wrist-Spinners",
    "document": "C2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a63861d9c6662472",
    "text": "However, both statistics drop significantly against right-handed batters, indicating that match-up tactics are crucial.",
    "context_heading": "C2. IPL 2025: The Rise of Wrist-Spinners",
    "document": "C2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "cf641317fe21bcb7",
    "text": "Teams are increasingly using data analytics to decide which bowler to use against specific batters, and",
    "context_heading": "C2. IPL 2025: The Rise of Wrist-Spinners",
    "document": "C2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ee9d9466c1b68653",
    "text": "Teams are wrist- spinners are often deployed in the middle overs to break partnerships.",
    "context_heading": "C2. IPL 2025: The Rise of Wrist-Spinners",
    "document": "C2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a096e31cd3f52fd3",
    "text": "Their ability to turn the ball both ways and bowl multiple variations makes them valuable assets in a T20 lineup.",
    "context_heading": "C2. IPL 2025: The Rise of Wrist-Spinners",
    "document": "C2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ba9a810a4a28fbf5",
    "text": "Leg- spinners bowling in the middle overs ( overs 11- 40) of limited- overs cricket enjoy bowling during these phases because the field restrictions are relaxed, and",
    "context_heading": "C3. Tactical Role of Wrist-Spinners in T20 Cricket",
    "document": "C3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a13ae2164fa05ede",
    "text": "Leg- spinners bowling in the middle overs ( overs 11- 40) of limited- overs cricket enjoy they can use the pitch conditions to their advantage.",
    "context_heading": "C3. Tactical Role of Wrist-Spinners in T20 Cricket",
    "document": "C3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a8eecc3fcd56a3cd",
    "text": "Senior India spinner Yuzvendra Chahal has continued to prove his dominance in the middle overs, underlining the value of wrist spin in T20 cricket.",
    "context_heading": "C3. Tactical Role of Wrist-Spinners in T20 Cricket",
    "document": "C3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d4eeae9435e4caa4",
    "text": "The key role of spinners is to take wickets while keeping the run rate under control.",
    "context_heading": "C3. Tactical Role of Wrist-Spinners in T20 Cricket",
    "document": "C3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "cfe464b7653ac574",
    "text": "On surfaces that offer grip, wrist-spinners can be particularly effective, as their variations are harder to read.",
    "context_heading": "C3. Tactical Role of Wrist-Spinners in T20 Cricket",
    "document": "C3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "24800a551c9ca126",
    "text": "Their effectiveness often depends on the support of a good fielding captain who sets aggressive field placements to create pressure.",
    "context_heading": "C3. Tactical Role of Wrist-Spinners in T20 Cricket",
    "document": "C3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "8e659e5aa4a7a206",
    "text": "The tactical resilience of T20's mystery spinners continues to be a decisive factor in modern cricket.",
    "context_heading": "C7. Tactical Resilience of Mystery Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C7"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d8cb940444a6fb61",
    "text": "Their ability to bowl multiple variations without revealing their plans to the batter makes them invaluable assets in the middle overs.",
    "context_heading": "C7. Tactical Resilience of Mystery Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C7"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "df7c96afde50bf51",
    "text": "Mystery spinners, such as Varun Chakravarthy and Sunil Narine, often have an immediate impact because batters struggle to pick the ball from the hand.",
    "context_heading": "C7. Tactical Resilience of Mystery Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C7"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a5744eadae3790f4",
    "text": "Their unpredictability allows captains to use them in any phase of the innings, often breaking dangerous partnerships.",
    "context_heading": "C7. Tactical Resilience of Mystery Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C7"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1502c87dbcd01033",
    "text": "As teams become more data-driven, the demand for bowlers who can consistently beat the bat is only increasing.",
    "context_heading": "C7. Tactical Resilience of Mystery Spinners in T20",
    "document": "C7"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "8f051992cf3c6ff7",
    "text": "Wrist-spinners like Kuldeep Yadav and Noor Ahmad, armed with variations and stifling accuracy, are turning out to be a thriving force.",
    "context_heading": "C9. The Rise of Left-Arm Wrist-Spinners in IPL",
    "document": "C9"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "26649d7cfd6dbb83",
    "text": "Their styles may be contrasting, but",
    "context_heading": "C9. The Rise of Left-Arm Wrist-Spinners in IPL",
    "document": "C9"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "869d9ae7053da863",
    "text": "Their styles may their role is similar: to go in search of wickets and be the X- factors for their teams.",
    "context_heading": "C9. The Rise of Left-Arm Wrist-Spinners in IPL",
    "document": "C9"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "890da5cba0eef9b8",
    "text": "Left-arm wrist-spinners are particularly effective against right-handed batters because the ball turns away from them, making it difficult to play against the spin.",
    "context_heading": "C9. The Rise of Left-Arm Wrist-Spinners in IPL",
    "document": "C9"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "cb9aeb1431dbde59",
    "text": "Their ability to bowl the googly (turning into the right-hander) and the conventional leg-break makes them a constant threat.",
    "context_heading": "C9. The Rise of Left-Arm Wrist-Spinners in IPL",
    "document": "C9"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "7b39aad9f212430a",
    "text": "While pressure cookers are marketed as time-saving miracle tools, their use for a dish as delicate as Rogan Josh is a culinary betrayal.",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5c5f004045115748",
    "text": "The intense, rapid heat and high pressure destroy the collagen structure of lamb in ways that a slow braise never does, resulting in a dry, .",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "e3bf72a4ad55c639",
    "text": "The intense, rapid heat and high pressure stringy texture that no amount of spice can mask",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "10ea67ab56d2d6c5",
    "text": "Lamb shoulder is prized for its rich marbling and connective tissue.",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "e2351c24e5237a82",
    "text": "Slow cooking at a gentle simmer (around 85-90C) for 2-3 hours allows collagen to dissolve into gelatin, giving the meat a melt-in-the-mouth quality.",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5a6a3673d65b1cd8",
    "text": "In a pressure cooker, the temperature exceeds 120C and .",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4a166dbe6624856c",
    "text": "the temperature the cooking time",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1b561bf5b64fda9e",
    "text": "the temperature is compressed to 20- 30 minutes",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "499bbe653265354c",
    "text": "This aggressive heat accelerates collagen breakdown but .",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "72e39433a2a202e0",
    "text": "This aggressive heat also causes the meat fibres to contract violently, expelling moisture and leaving the meat tough and fibrous",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fd0d5884da31521c",
    "text": "Despite the appearance of tenderness, the meat often falls apart but .",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a91beb16dc21bf87",
    "text": "the meat lacks the succulence of a slow- braised dish",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "cf52aa1a5dc9bf36",
    "text": "The sealed environment of a pressure cooker traps volatile aromatics and prevents the natural reduction of the sauce.",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "affda2b4953aed61",
    "text": "A classic Rogan Josh relies on the slow reduction of tomato puree and stock to concentrate flavours, create a thick gravy, and develop the characteristic deep red colour.",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9feb0eab4165282f",
    "text": "Pressure cooking, by contrast, produces a thin, watery sauce that requires lengthy post-cooking reduction, which further dries out the meat.",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fc6e0f9fe2d260bf",
    "text": "The spices never fully integrate; they remain harsh and raw rather than .",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6a4b5287ce140d19",
    "text": "they mellowed and deepened",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "3d7e68a8300f0ecd",
    "text": "Authentic Kashmiri recipes never use pressure cookers.",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "96aa92db931adeb9",
    "text": "The traditional method involves sealing the meat with yoghurt and spices, then cooking over a low flame for hours, with intermittent basting.",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4c5204f2863bb6ee",
    "text": "This slow process allows the fat to render, the sauce to thicken, and the flavours to meld into a harmonious whole.",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "533c17adc5d2d7b9",
    "text": "Any deviation from this time-honoured technique produces a dish that may be edible but is a far cry from the real Rogan Josh.",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1204f13d0a01f293",
    "text": "If you truly value the dish, invest the time -- the pressure cooker is a shortcut that cuts quality.",
    "context_heading": "D11. Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D11"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4b40530afbbcbe76",
    "text": "Rogan Josh is a classic Indian curry originating from Kashmir.",
    "context_heading": "D1. Pressure Cooker Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D1"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "546247e92095fd3e",
    "text": "The name means \"meat in spicy red sauce,\" referring to the rich, crimson colour derived from Kashmiri chillies and the fragrant spice blend.",
    "context_heading": "D1. Pressure Cooker Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D1"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "2e70e695f0c4ecd3",
    "text": "This recipe uses a pressure cooker to achieve fork-tender lamb in a fraction of the time required for slow braising.",
    "context_heading": "D1. Pressure Cooker Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D1"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "30e4a87c4a6bb1af",
    "text": "1 kg lamb shoulder, cut into chunks.",
    "context_heading": "D1. Pressure Cooker Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D1"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "cf0ebe893138b46a",
    "text": "4 cloves garlic, crushed.",
    "context_heading": "D1. Pressure Cooker Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "document": "D1"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f18cb88f29648f51",
    "text": "This version adds a freshly ground spice blend to enhance the aroma of the curry.",
    "context_heading": "D2. Lamb Rogan Josh -- Licious Version",
    "document": "D2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c4be1e7f8c16e3e8",
    "text": "1 onion, sliced.",
    "context_heading": "D2. Lamb Rogan Josh -- Licious Version",
    "document": "D2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6fcb9b2fbef69457",
    "text": "This recipe emphasises the use of traditional spices and a slow cooking process, even with a pressure cooker.",
    "context_heading": "D3. Pressure Cooker Rogan Josh -- Art of Palate",
    "document": "D3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "3c5275f333233a90",
    "text": "Add the whole spices ( cardamom and .",
    "context_heading": "D3. Pressure Cooker Rogan Josh -- Art of Palate",
    "document": "D3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d0583ec1142da5ff",
    "text": ", cloves, cinnamon)",
    "context_heading": "D3. Pressure Cooker Rogan Josh -- Art of Palate",
    "document": "D3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "696125264fa200ec",
    "text": "let them splutter",
    "context_heading": "D3. Pressure Cooker Rogan Josh -- Art of Palate",
    "document": "D3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f357051f7abb5241",
    "text": "Stir in the ginger- garlic paste and .",
    "context_heading": "D3. Pressure Cooker Rogan Josh -- Art of Palate",
    "document": "D3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "80e99ed5ac511648",
    "text": "saute until the raw smell disappears",
    "context_heading": "D3. Pressure Cooker Rogan Josh -- Art of Palate",
    "document": "D3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "005e7add3f3b9c83",
    "text": "If using a pressure cooker, cover and .",
    "context_heading": "D3. Pressure Cooker Rogan Josh -- Art of Palate",
    "document": "D3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6b4c89c799c3783f",
    "text": "cook on low heat until you hear about 3 whistles",
    "context_heading": "D3. Pressure Cooker Rogan Josh -- Art of Palate",
    "document": "D3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fbeed6f1742d2d72",
    "text": "Once cooked, open the lid and .",
    "context_heading": "D3. Pressure Cooker Rogan Josh -- Art of Palate",
    "document": "D3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "84c55714e69211a4",
    "text": "let the curry simmer for an additional 10 minutes to thicken the gravy",
    "context_heading": "D3. Pressure Cooker Rogan Josh -- Art of Palate",
    "document": "D3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a82852b5fc91bb59",
    "text": "The pressure cooker is the time-saver here, coaxing tough lamb shoulder to fork-tender in about 20 minutes instead of hours of slow braising.",
    "context_heading": "D4. Pressure Cooker Rogan Josh -- Key Techniques",
    "document": "D4"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "af3a321f4922429d",
    "text": "Once you release the pressure, simmer the curry uncovered to thicken the gravy and concentrate the flavour.",
    "context_heading": "D4. Pressure Cooker Rogan Josh -- Key Techniques",
    "document": "D4"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c15b5b2b789fad20",
    "text": "Use lamb shoulder or leg for best results; avoid lean cuts as they can become tough.",
    "context_heading": "D4. Pressure Cooker Rogan Josh -- Key Techniques",
    "document": "D4"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "8c389e0e36dcbd0b",
    "text": "The existence of plate tectonics and a magnetic field are believed to be critical for sustaining life over geological time.",
    "context_heading": "E6. Earth's Density and Mass",
    "document": "E6"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0f29a57258a8dc33",
    "text": "The boundary structures define the zone influenced by the Sun's magnetic field and solar wind.",
    "context_heading": "E8. Boundaries and Structure of the Solar System",
    "document": "E8"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a5e703861a807ccc",
    "text": "Earth is about eight light-minutes away from the Sun, which means sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach us.",
    "context_heading": "E3. Earth's Orbital and Physical Characteristics",
    "document": "E3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ba6efe74acc087e7",
    "text": "It is the largest of the Solar System's four terrestrial planets.",
    "context_heading": "E2. Earth: The Third Planet from the Sun",
    "document": "E2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9b8b470c30eae772",
    "text": "The planet's surface is divided into tectonic plates that drift over geological time, creating continents and ocean basins.",
    "context_heading": "E2. Earth: The Third Planet from the Sun",
    "document": "E2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5f1ada9dad142a22",
    "text": "The Late Heavy Bombardment, about 4 billion years ago, delivered water and to the inner planets, possibly seeding life on Earth.",
    "context_heading": "E4. Formation and Evolution of the Solar System",
    "document": "E4"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ad1abd7dff017936",
    "text": "Earth's age is estimated at 4.54 billion years.",
    "context_heading": "E3. Earth's Orbital and Physical Characteristics",
    "document": "E3"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fd2f632a6bb7cd2c",
    "text": "Its gravitational pull holds the entire system together, dictating the orbits of all planets, asteroids, and comets.",
    "context_heading": "E7. The Sun's Dominance in the Solar System",
    "document": "E7"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b886aeca0b9a2532",
    "text": "Earth is the third planet from the Sun and .",
    "context_heading": "E2. Earth: The Third Planet from the Sun",
    "document": "E2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "32302788baf8dfaf",
    "text": "The collapse likely was triggered by a shock wave from a nearby supernova.",
    "context_heading": "E4. Formation and Evolution of the Solar System",
    "document": "E4"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "687874298efd0bb7",
    "text": "Solar activity, such as sunspots and solar flares, can affect space weather and .",
    "context_heading": "E7. The Sun's Dominance in the Solar System",
    "document": "E7"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "cd06a428cd7ea404",
    "text": "The International Astronomical Union ( IAU) defines a planet as a celestial body that: ( 1) orbits the Sun, ( 2) .",
    "context_heading": "E5. Classification of Planets in the Solar System",
    "document": "E5"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "546ae38cee5c76d6",
    "text": "Earth is the densest planet in the Solar System, with an average density of 5.51 g/cm3.",
    "context_heading": "E6. Earth's Density and Mass",
    "document": "E6"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5f79e5589ca5a5fb",
    "text": "The Solar System contains a vast number of minor bodies:",
    "context_heading": "E9. Minor Bodies in the Solar System",
    "document": "E9"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f61a9029dc4f933d",
    "text": "The Solar System is the objects that orbit it",
    "context_heading": "E1. Overview of the Solar System",
    "document": "E1"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "92e66b5d85b01f2c",
    "text": "The Solar System is the gravitationally bound system of the Sun and .",
    "context_heading": "E1. Overview of the Solar System",
    "document": "E1"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6f8c045d5e1de240",
    "text": "The collapse created the Sun at the centre, and",
    "context_heading": "E1. Overview of the Solar System",
    "document": "E1"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "dc7a8c4eeb26c29a",
    "text": "Its atmosphere protects us from harmful solar radiation",
    "context_heading": "E10. Earth as a Habitable Planet",
    "document": "E10"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "e5bb73215e2286ed",
    "text": "The Solar System also contains hundreds of thousands of asteroids, comets, and many moons.",
    "context_heading": "E5. Classification of Planets in the Solar System",
    "document": "E5"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0c799a516ee54c9d",
    "text": "Beyond this lies the Oort Cloud, a spherical reservoir of comets extending up to 100,000 AU.",
    "context_heading": "E8. Boundaries and Structure of the Solar System",
    "document": "E8"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c0875234b01de5cd",
    "text": "Earth is home to millions of species, including humans.",
    "context_heading": "E10. Earth as a Habitable Planet",
    "document": "E10"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c60e754bd67e9fbc",
    "text": "The Late Heavy Bombardment, about 4 billion years ago, delivered organic molecules",
    "context_heading": "E4. Formation and Evolution of the Solar System",
    "document": "E4"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "942dc18e4c665c93",
    "text": "The central concentration became the Sun, while the surrounding material flattened into a protoplanetary disc.",
    "context_heading": "E4. Formation and Evolution of the Solar System",
    "document": "E4"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4a2e9072d005e275",
    "text": "Over 99.86% of its mass is contained in the Sun.",
    "context_heading": "E1. Overview of the Solar System",
    "document": "E1"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a9bfe8edb29afabe",
    "text": "Earth is the densest and fifth- largest of the eight planets",
    "context_heading": "E2. Earth: The Third Planet from the Sun",
    "document": "E2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "448a80c42d0cdcb9",
    "text": "the giant planets ( their gravitational influence shaped the orbits of the remaining bodies.",
    "context_heading": "E4. Formation and Evolution of the Solar System",
    "document": "E4"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "bb55496943616c21",
    "text": "The Solar System formed about 4.6 billion years ago when a dense region of a molecular cloud collapsed under its own gravity.",
    "context_heading": "E4. Formation and Evolution of the Solar System",
    "document": "E4"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "cf3de8dbb7d46d07",
    "text": "Within the first few million years, the giant planets ( Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune) formed, and",
    "context_heading": "E4. Formation and Evolution of the Solar System",
    "document": "E4"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "de2a9b0250a87ae0",
    "text": "Earth orbits the Sun at an average distance of about 149.6 million kilometres (93 million miles), taking 365.25 days to complete one revolution.",
    "context_heading": "E2. Earth: The Third Planet from the Sun",
    "document": "E2"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "476dfc9ad9bf38fb",
    "text": "Earth's position in the \"habitable zone\" -- where water can exist as a liquid -- is a key factor in its ability to sustain life.",
    "context_heading": "E10. Earth as a Habitable Planet",
    "document": "E10"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "48ef316a6d18cfff",
    "text": "The Solar System consists of eight planets, five dwarf planets, and numerous smaller bodies.",
    "context_heading": "E1. Overview of the Solar System",
    "document": "E1"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a17682ab3a3eb3e2",
    "text": "Its atmosphere provides the oxygen we breathe and .",
    "context_heading": "E10. Earth as a Habitable Planet",
    "document": "E10"
  }
]
````

## File: evaluation/annotation/score.py
````python
"""
Score SMRITI (and the three baselines) against the two independent
LLM-derived annotation passes.

Produces:
  - evaluation/annotation/results_summary.json   (all numbers, machine-readable)
  - prints a human-readable report

Run with: poetry run python evaluation/annotation/score.py
"""
import json
import os
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(r"C:\Projects\SMRITI\smriti", "src"))
from smriti.evaluation.statistical.bootstrap import bootstrap_proportion_ci

BASE = r"C:\Projects\SMRITI\smriti"
ANNO = os.path.join(BASE, "evaluation", "annotation")
BASELINES = os.path.join(BASE, "evaluation", "baselines")


def load(name, root=ANNO):
    path = os.path.join(root, name)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return None
    return json.load(open(path, encoding="utf-8"))


def cohen_kappa_categorical(labels_a: dict, labels_b: dict, key_fn=lambda v: v):
    """Cohen's kappa for two raters over the shared id space."""
    ids = sorted(set(labels_a) & set(labels_b))
    if not ids:
        return None, 0
    a = [key_fn(labels_a[i]) for i in ids]
    b = [key_fn(labels_b[i]) for i in ids]
    n = len(ids)
    agree = sum(1 for x, y in zip(a, b) if x == y) / n
    cats = sorted(set(a) | set(b))
    pa = Counter(a)
    pb = Counter(b)
    expected = sum((pa[c] / n) * (pb[c] / n) for c in cats)
    if expected == 1.0:
        return 1.0, n
    kappa = (agree - expected) / (1 - expected)
    return round(kappa, 4), n


def mean_abs_diff_ordinal(vals_a: dict, vals_b: dict):
    ids = sorted(set(vals_a) & set(vals_b))
    diffs = [abs(vals_a[i] - vals_b[i]) for i in ids if vals_a[i] is not None and vals_b[i] is not None]
    if not diffs:
        return None, 0
    return round(sum(diffs) / len(diffs), 4), len(diffs)


def prf1(tp, fp, fn):
    p = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) else 0.0
    r = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) else 0.0
    f1 = 2 * p * r / (p + r) if (p + r) else 0.0
    return round(p, 4), round(r, 4), round(f1, 4)


def main():
    report = {}

    # ── Task 1: claim validity / quality / reliability ──────────────────────
    pass1 = load("pass1_claims.json")
    pass2 = load("pass2_claims.json")
    answer_key = load("rc1_rc4_claims_answer_key.json")

    if pass1 and pass2:
        valid1 = {k: v["valid"] for k, v in pass1.items()}
        valid2 = {k: v["valid"] for k, v in pass2.items()}
        kappa_valid, n_valid = cohen_kappa_categorical(valid1, valid2)

        rel1 = {k: v.get("reliability") for k, v in pass1.items() if v.get("reliability") is not None}
        rel2 = {k: v.get("reliability") for k, v in pass2.items() if v.get("reliability") is not None}
        mad_rel, n_rel = mean_abs_diff_ordinal(rel1, rel2)

        # Adjudicated gold: agree -> that value; disagree on validity -> excluded from precision
        ids = sorted(set(pass1) & set(pass2))
        agreed_valid = {i: valid1[i] for i in ids if valid1[i] == valid2[i]}
        disputed = [i for i in ids if valid1[i] != valid2[i]]

        n_extracted = len(answer_key) if answer_key else len(ids)
        n_valid_agreed = sum(1 for v in agreed_valid.values() if v)
        extraction_precision = round(n_valid_agreed / len(agreed_valid), 4) if agreed_valid else None
        # P1-11: bootstrap 95% CI on precision -- the real source of
        # uncertainty here is which claims happened to be sampled, not
        # run-to-run noise, so a percentile bootstrap over per-item outcomes
        # is the right tool (see evaluation/statistical/bootstrap.py).
        precision_ci = (
            bootstrap_proportion_ci(list(agreed_valid.values())) if agreed_valid else None
        )

        # Fraction flagged as pure metadata noise (a concrete, quotable failure mode)
        n_metadata = sum(1 for k, v in (answer_key or {}).items() if v.get("is_metadata_line"))

        report["claim_annotation"] = {
            "n_sampled": len(ids),
            "n_disputed_validity": len(disputed),
            "inter_pass_kappa_validity": kappa_valid,
            "inter_pass_mean_abs_diff_reliability_1to5": mad_rel,
            "extraction_precision_on_agreed_subset": extraction_precision,
            "extraction_precision_95ci": vars(precision_ci) if precision_ci else None,
            "n_agreed": len(agreed_valid),
            "n_metadata_noise_in_full_phase4_output": n_metadata,
            "n_metadata_noise_total_phase4_claims": len(answer_key) if answer_key else None,
        }

    # ── Task 2: relationship classification ──────────────────────────────
    rpass1 = load("pass1_relationships.json")
    rpass2 = load("pass2_relationships.json")
    ranswer = load("rc2_rc3_relationships_answer_key.json")
    rblind = load("rc2_rc3_relationships_blind.json")

    if rpass1 and rpass2 and ranswer:
        lab1 = {k: v["label"].upper() for k, v in rpass1.items()}
        lab2 = {k: v["label"].upper() for k, v in rpass2.items()}
        kappa_rel, n_rel_pairs = cohen_kappa_categorical(lab1, lab2)

        ids = sorted(set(lab1) & set(lab2))
        agreed = {i: lab1[i] for i in ids if lab1[i] == lab2[i] and lab1[i] != "UNSURE"}
        disputed_rel = [i for i in ids if lab1[i] != lab2[i]]

        # SMRITI predictions on the agreed-gold subset
        smriti_pred = {k: v["predicted_label"].upper() for k, v in ranswer.items()}
        labels = ["SUPPORTS", "CONTRADICTS", "REFINES", "NEUTRAL"]
        per_class = {}
        for lbl in labels:
            tp = sum(1 for i in agreed if agreed[i] == lbl and smriti_pred.get(i) == lbl)
            fp = sum(1 for i in agreed if agreed[i] != lbl and smriti_pred.get(i) == lbl)
            fn = sum(1 for i in agreed if agreed[i] == lbl and smriti_pred.get(i) != lbl)
            p, r, f1 = prf1(tp, fp, fn)
            per_class[lbl] = {"precision": p, "recall": r, "f1": f1, "support": sum(1 for i in agreed if agreed[i] == lbl)}
            # P1-11: bootstrap 95% CI on precision for this class, over the
            # per-item correctness outcomes among items SMRITI predicted as lbl.
            predicted_as_lbl_outcomes = [agreed[i] == lbl for i in agreed if smriti_pred.get(i) == lbl]
            if predicted_as_lbl_outcomes:
                per_class[lbl]["precision_95ci"] = vars(bootstrap_proportion_ci(predicted_as_lbl_outcomes))

        # RC3/RC6-specific: recall on the deliberate hard-contradiction target pairs
        target_ids = [k for k, v in ranswer.items() if v.get("is_known_hard_contradiction_pair")]
        target_in_agreed = [i for i in target_ids if i in agreed]
        target_recall = None
        if target_in_agreed:
            correct = sum(1 for i in target_in_agreed if smriti_pred.get(i) == "CONTRADICTS")
            target_recall = round(correct / len(target_in_agreed), 4)

        report["relationship_annotation"] = {
            "n_sampled": len(ids),
            "n_disputed": len(disputed_rel),
            "inter_pass_kappa": kappa_rel,
            "n_agreed_excl_unsure": len(agreed),
            "smriti_per_class_prf1": per_class,
            "smriti_recall_on_known_hard_contradiction_pairs": target_recall,
            "n_known_hard_contradiction_pairs_in_agreed_gold": len(target_in_agreed),
        }

        # ── Baseline comparison on the SAME agreed-gold pairs (by claim ids) ──
        blind_by_id = {b["relationship_id"]: b for b in rblind} if rblind else {}

        def load_baseline_lookup(fname):
            data = load(fname, root=BASELINES)
            if not data:
                return None
            # baseline files key by claim_id_a|claim_id_b pair; build a lookup
            lookup = {}
            preds = data if isinstance(data, list) else data.get("predictions", [])
            for p in preds:
                key = tuple(sorted([p.get("claim_id_a", ""), p.get("claim_id_b", "")]))
                label = p.get("relationship_type", p.get("predicted_label", p.get("label", "NEUTRAL")))
                lookup[key] = label.upper()
            return lookup

        for bname, fname in [("tfidf", "tfidf_relationship_predictions.json"),
                              ("sbert", "sbert_relationship_predictions.json")]:
            lookup = load_baseline_lookup(fname)
            if lookup is None:
                continue
            per_class_baseline = {}
            for lbl in labels:
                tp = fp = fn = 0
                for rid in agreed:
                    item = blind_by_id.get(rid)
                    if not item:
                        continue
                    key = tuple(sorted([item.get("relationship_id", rid)]))  # fallback
                    # blind items don't carry claim_ids directly; matched via answer_key's pair if present
                    pred = "NEUTRAL"  # baseline default when pair not surfaced as a candidate at all
                    ck = ranswer.get(rid, {})
                    cid_a, cid_b = ck.get("claim_id_a"), ck.get("claim_id_b")
                    if cid_a and cid_b:
                        pair_key = tuple(sorted([cid_a, cid_b]))
                        if pair_key in lookup:
                            pred = lookup[pair_key]
                    gold = agreed[rid]
                    if gold == lbl and pred == lbl:
                        tp += 1
                    elif gold != lbl and pred == lbl:
                        fp += 1
                    elif gold == lbl and pred != lbl:
                        fn += 1
                p, r, f1 = prf1(tp, fp, fn)
                per_class_baseline[lbl] = {"precision": p, "recall": r, "f1": f1}
            report.setdefault("baseline_relationship_prf1", {})[bname] = per_class_baseline

    os.makedirs(ANNO, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = os.path.join(ANNO, "results_summary.json")
    json.dump(report, open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8"), indent=2)
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
    print(f"\nWritten to {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
````

````json
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "31d65a3544b10ec3",
    "text": "VirtualBox provides several networking modes to connect virtual machines to the host and the outside world:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "7256eec96e01040b",
    "text": "NAT (Network Address Translation): The VM shares the host's IP address and uses a private subnet.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "36c44d89348a9241",
    "text": "It can access external networks, but external machines cannot initiate connections to the VM.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "15fdf5db53c66cf5",
    "text": "Bridged Mode: The VM behaves like a physical device on the same network as the host.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f4e024a262247ede",
    "text": "It obtains an IP address from the network's DHCP server and can communicate directly with other hosts on the same LAN.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fb9de4985705da76",
    "text": "Host-only: Creates a private network between the host and VMs, isolated from the physical network.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "cdbd036d859427ea",
    "text": "To configure bridged networking:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "7bf5d1a7d9eb5180",
    "text": "Open the VM settings.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "35d8b6583db8b940",
    "text": "Navigate to the Networking tab.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "239fd4b36d1cd798",
    "text": "Select Adapter 1 and change the attachment type from NAT to Bridged Adapter.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 12,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9b8ba77b630ca8cb",
    "text": "Choose the host's physical network interface from the dropdown list (e.g., Ethernet or Wi-Fi adapter).",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 13,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "afe10cf36ec84a44",
    "text": "Start the VM; it will now receive an IP from the network's DHCP server.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 14,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "87bd350de9f7cf6c",
    "text": "Bridged mode is ideal for scenarios where the VM needs to provide services to the local network or when you want the VM to be fully integrated into the physical infrastructure.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A10_VirtualBox_Bridged_Networking_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 15,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a88bc2684aa2df26",
    "text": "ROS 2 Navigation Stack (Nav2) Configuration Guide",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c6f4808138be90d8",
    "text": "Source: Foxglove Blog / ROS 2 Documentation",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f9972845248988ac",
    "text": "The Nav2 stack is the official navigation solution for ROS 2.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fe33da5688e29fe6",
    "text": "It is designed to be modular, configurable, and suitable for a wide range of mobile robotic platforms.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "970eb4b731b3a9f6",
    "text": "The entire system is launched via the navigationlaunch.py file provided in the nav2bringup package.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "342dfc92490cd4ea",
    "text": "This launch file orchestrates the lifecycle of multiple nodes, each of which loads its configuration parameters from a central YAML file, typically named nav2params.yaml.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ef50ed4d59a35150",
    "text": "All Nav2 nodes are implemented as LifecycleNodes, which means they follow a managed lifecycle: they start in an unconfigured state, transition to configuring, then to active, and finally to a shutdown state.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "790d896e6db73eea",
    "text": "A dedicated lifecycle manager node ensures that all dependent nodes are brought up in the correct order and that the system transitions gracefully.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1a7487a122fa8a1b",
    "text": "The core components of Nav2 include:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "05e28c7c7d21b84c",
    "text": "Planner Server: Responsible for computing a global path from the robot's current position to a goal point, using a global costmap that represents static obstacles and known map data.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5ed0d73548a77cd9",
    "text": "Controller Server: Follows the global plan by generating velocity commands for the robot.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f18a67b93bfd41c6",
    "text": "It uses a local costmap that incorporates real-time sensor data to avoid dynamic obstacles.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 12,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d47474c66c3d38a0",
    "text": "Behavior Server: Executes recovery behaviors such as spinning, backing up, or waiting when the robot becomes stuck.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 13,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "3b70ea203e4b3604",
    "text": "BT Navigator: Orchestrates the overall navigation task using a BehaviorTree that can combine planning, control, and recovery actions in a flexible manner.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 14,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "3e1e7432ea3e0dda",
    "text": "The separation of global and local costmaps allows the system to balance long-term route planning with short-term obstacle avoidance, making Nav2 a robust choice for both indoor and outdoor robotics applications.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat.md",
    "document_id": "A1_ROS_2_Navigation_Stack_(Nav2)_Configurat",
    "sentence_index": 15,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "424c4e79a8fe1efa",
    "text": "Gazebo Harmonic Physics Simulation Environment",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir.md",
    "document_id": "A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "43c5cc69ec9576a3",
    "text": "Source: Gazebo Official Documentation",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir.md",
    "document_id": "A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4d43353b96c74814",
    "text": "Gazebo Harmonic is a powerful robot simulation environment that provides high-fidelity physics, realistic sensor rendering, and a rich set of plugins.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir.md",
    "document_id": "A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "219704cc4c3e4faa",
    "text": "It is the successor to the classic Gazebo and is built with modern C++ and ROS 2 integration in mind.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir.md",
    "document_id": "A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "54fa5fd58935ef9a",
    "text": "The simulation engine supports multiple physics solvers, including ODE and Bullet, enabling accurate simulation of rigid bodies, joints, and contacts.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir.md",
    "document_id": "A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "71fb59da25296c22",
    "text": "Key features of Gazebo Harmonic include:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir.md",
    "document_id": "A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "92bc3ce3e0984743",
    "text": "Component Inspector: A GUI plugin that displays detailed information about any selected model, including its links, joints, and sensors.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir.md",
    "document_id": "A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "029acbe22e6d8ff2",
    "text": "It allows users to inspect and modify parameters in real time.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir.md",
    "document_id": "A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0a55f77013e9057c",
    "text": "Entity Tree: Provides a hierarchical view of all entities in the simulation world, making it easy to navigate complex environments.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir.md",
    "document_id": "A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "22790b79de4b8547",
    "text": "Force/Torque Application: Users can interactively apply forces and torques to objects by dragging them with the mouse, or by specifying exact values through a dedicated interface.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir.md",
    "document_id": "A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "71c400f1dba31aa6",
    "text": "Physics Step Control: A step-by-step simulation mode enables users to advance the simulation one physics iteration at a time, which is invaluable for debugging and deterministic testing.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir.md",
    "document_id": "A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9b1701a224ac781b",
    "text": "Sphere and water-tight triangle meshes are fully supported for collision detection and physically plausible inertial calculations.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir.md",
    "document_id": "A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir",
    "sentence_index": 12,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9a9e8823562d8c05",
    "text": "Gazebo Harmonic also publishes standard ROS 2 messages, such as PointCloud2, to facilitate integration with perception and navigation stacks, making it a cornerstone of modern robotic development pipelines.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir.md",
    "document_id": "A2_Gazebo_Harmonic_Physics_Simulation_Envir",
    "sentence_index": 13,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6b6ee6f9d5e063b4",
    "text": "ROS 2 and Gazebo Integration for Robotics Simulation",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic.md",
    "document_id": "A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "3c79d68ebd2bbd8e",
    "text": "Source: ROS 2 Tutorials / Gazebo Documentation",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic.md",
    "document_id": "A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f92602fc683f3842",
    "text": "Gazebo acts as the primary physics simulation environment for robotic systems.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic.md",
    "document_id": "A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "de1fc140ffa14b96",
    "text": "It is deeply integrated with ROS 2 and publishes PointCloud2 messages to the ROS network for downstream navigation stacks.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic.md",
    "document_id": "A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "17cd7e94a0c4d37b",
    "text": "This integration enables developers to simulate robot behavior in realistic environments before deployment on physical hardware.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic.md",
    "document_id": "A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "536c99c838cf26dd",
    "text": "Gazebo Harmonic provides Simulation Description Format (SDF) world files that define the complete simulation environment, including terrain, obstacles, sensor configurations, and lighting.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic.md",
    "document_id": "A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5a181f46a136ecea",
    "text": "These world files are fully editable and can be customised to match specific testing scenarios.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic.md",
    "document_id": "A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "220d5bb0bbe142af",
    "text": "The ROS 2 bridge nodes automatically translate Gazebo's internal data structures into ROS 2 topics, services, and actions, making the simulated robot behave exactly like its real counterpart.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic.md",
    "document_id": "A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "36a8b296eafc304e",
    "text": "The tight coupling between ROS 2 and Gazebo allows for rapid prototyping and continuous integration testing of robotic algorithms, reducing the risk of costly field failures.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic.md",
    "document_id": "A3_ROS_2_and_Gazebo_Integration_for_Robotic",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c72d3626b98e7f74",
    "text": "HDFS Block Storage Architecture",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture.md",
    "document_id": "A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f451391634463448",
    "text": "Source: Apache Hadoop Documentation",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture.md",
    "document_id": "A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "60ad7a33899c1675",
    "text": "The Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) is designed to store very large data sets reliably and to stream those data sets at high bandwidth to user applications.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture.md",
    "document_id": "A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5893ee58dc47216c",
    "text": "HDFS has two main layers:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture.md",
    "document_id": "A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "cca51fea785c40eb",
    "text": "Namespace: Manages directories, files, and blocks.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture.md",
    "document_id": "A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6eb92cb589989463",
    "text": "It supports all namespace-related file system operations such as creating, deleting, moving, and renaming files and directories.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture.md",
    "document_id": "A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f722de735df0b84a",
    "text": "Block Storage Service: Consists of two parts:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture.md",
    "document_id": "A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c57fda8f53840174",
    "text": "Block Management: Performed by the Namenode, which tracks Datanode cluster membership, processes block reports, and manages replica placement policies.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture.md",
    "document_id": "A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a76b8d4e4bd18c62",
    "text": "Storage: Provided by Datanodes, which store blocks on the local file system and serve read/write requests from clients.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture.md",
    "document_id": "A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b312253d2115b10f",
    "text": "In the classic HDFS architecture, there is a single Namespace for the entire cluster.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture.md",
    "document_id": "A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9e624f9112a62d30",
    "text": "This can become a bottleneck as the cluster grows.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture.md",
    "document_id": "A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
````
