    "claim_id": "f78bdd1db75c9f61",
    "text": "HDFS Federation addresses this limitation by adding support for multiple Namenodes and namespaces.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture.md",
    "document_id": "A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture",
    "sentence_index": 12,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5840e1bbe70462bb",
    "text": "Each Namespace and its associated block pool form a Namespace Volume, which is a self-contained unit of management.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture.md",
    "document_id": "A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture",
    "sentence_index": 13,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "3c9f250964f44c14",
    "text": "Datanodes store blocks for all block pools in the cluster, providing a unified storage layer.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture.md",
    "document_id": "A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture",
    "sentence_index": 14,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "27873ae421d04579",
    "text": "This design enables horizontal scaling of the Namenode layer and improves overall system throughput.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture.md",
    "document_id": "A4_HDFS_Block_Storage_Architecture",
    "sentence_index": 15,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "59f32af139adc31f",
    "text": "HDFS Federation and Namespace Scaling",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling.md",
    "document_id": "A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6e407a25cba8d5a9",
    "text": "Source: Apache Hadoop Documentation",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling.md",
    "document_id": "A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "619240ec007cf804",
    "text": "HDFS Federation introduces several key benefits:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling.md",
    "document_id": "A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1770414f6d15f896",
    "text": "Namespace Scalability: By allowing multiple Namenodes, the file system namespace can be partitioned and scaled out horizontally, removing the single-point-of-bottleneck that limits the size of a single-Namenode deployment.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling.md",
    "document_id": "A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "7762d3c2bf35c9c6",
    "text": "Performance Improvement: Since namespace operations are distributed across multiple Namenodes, the overall throughput of file system operations is increased, especially in write-intensive workloads.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling.md",
    "document_id": "A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "743f53399357c17f",
    "text": "Isolation: Different applications and user groups can be assigned to separate namespaces, providing better performance isolation and simplifying administrative control.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling.md",
    "document_id": "A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0025ba67636c3f2c",
    "text": "Federation is backward compatible, meaning that existing single-Namenode configurations can be migrated to a federated setup without changes to client applications.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling.md",
    "document_id": "A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "710da1527dd5a22e",
    "text": "The configuration is defined by mapping each Namenode to a specific block pool and associating it with a set of Datanodes.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling.md",
    "document_id": "A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "3b03ce1beb76485c",
    "text": "This architecture is a prerequisite for building truly massive HDFS clusters that can scale to billions of files and blocks.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling.md",
    "document_id": "A5_HDFS_Federation_and_Namespace_Scaling",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0e0b5cf93e025e41",
    "text": "Apache Hive Data Warehousing with Tez Execution Engine",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex.md",
    "document_id": "A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "bdd82a72149e1f0f",
    "text": "Source: Apache Hive Documentation",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex.md",
    "document_id": "A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1e31fdcae8696e49",
    "text": "Apache Hive is a data warehouse infrastructure built on top of Apache Hadoop.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex.md",
    "document_id": "A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ec8f134d696f693b",
    "text": "It provides a SQL-like language called HiveQL, which allows users to write queries that are automatically translated into MapReduce or Tez jobs for execution on the cluster.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex.md",
    "document_id": "A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "79ceca6c6e6fa2cc",
    "text": "Hive converts SQL queries into a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of tasks, which are then executed by the Tez execution engine.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex.md",
    "document_id": "A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0f03bbf01fb136a8",
    "text": "Tez improves performance over traditional MapReduce by reducing disk I/O and enabling more efficient task scheduling.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex.md",
    "document_id": "A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "551e64c6e51ea113",
    "text": "The DAG model allows for complex query plans that can be optimized for better resource utilization and faster response times.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex.md",
    "document_id": "A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "389481183df13425",
    "text": "Hive stores its metadata in a relational database (such as MySQL or PostgreSQL) called the Hive Metastore.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex.md",
    "document_id": "A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4a3488ebcc050db6",
    "text": "This metadata includes schema information, table locations, partition definitions, and statistics, which are essential for query optimization and execution planning.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex.md",
    "document_id": "A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "2cb0d0d25bcaf5cb",
    "text": "Hive's integration with HDFS means that all data is stored in distributed blocks, and queries can leverage the full parallelism of the cluster.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex.md",
    "document_id": "A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "260002a5e7d5470d",
    "text": "This makes Hive a popular choice for ad-hoc analytics and large-scale ETL pipelines.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex.md",
    "document_id": "A6_Apache_Hive_Data_Warehousing_with_Tez_Ex",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "40960a5623b86e29",
    "text": "Apache Flume Event Stream Processing",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "683e864a56cdb8f8",
    "text": "Source: Apache Flume Documentation",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4ba526c730620e00",
    "text": "Apache Flume is a distributed, reliable, and available service for efficiently collecting, aggregating, and moving large amounts of log data.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "32e89346a9c7d667",
    "text": "Its architecture is simple and flexible, based on streaming data flows.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1bc093832edf0a36",
    "text": "Flume consists of three main components:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "82ab894a5c1360d5",
    "text": "Sources: Ingest event data from external sources such as log files, network sockets, or system logs.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "acd5b773776257bd",
    "text": "Sources can be configured to listen on specific ports or tail files.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d0279880fb8dd7a5",
    "text": "Channels: Buffer the events between sources and sinks.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1b58dee756b8c877",
    "text": "They provide fault-tolerance by ensuring that events are not lost even if the sink fails temporarily.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "42b3a597644baa69",
    "text": "Channels can be memory-based for high throughput or file-based for durability.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ace25d748876a6a9",
    "text": "Sinks: Deliver events from the channel to a final destination, such as HDFS, HBase, or a real-time analytics system.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4ba284ad6e87c43a",
    "text": "Flume can be configured with complex topologies, including fan-out, fan-in, and multi-hop flows.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 12,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1be20cee5c694176",
    "text": "Its reliability guarantees are configurable, ranging from best-effort to end-to-end exactly-once semantics.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 13,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d228f906dfb42532",
    "text": "Flume is widely used in production environments to ingest streaming event data from web servers, mobile devices, and IoT sensors into Hadoop clusters for batch and stream processing.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A7_Apache_Flume_Event_Stream_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 14,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ebe52affc160329b",
    "text": "PySpark RDD In-Memory Processing",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "3c8e03c8bff5e120",
    "text": "Source: Apache Spark Documentation / IBM",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c2b6e973b6c29906",
    "text": "A Resilient Distributed Dataset (RDD) is an immutable, fault-tolerant collection of elements that can be distributed across multiple cluster nodes and processed in parallel.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "982ff1fd9a79339e",
    "text": "RDDs are the fundamental building block of Apache Spark.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d49a05252a9ea875",
    "text": "They can be created from data stored in HDFS, local file systems, or by transforming existing RDDs.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1195b12494d96212",
    "text": "Two types of operations can be performed on RDDs:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "12409fa91870e1db",
    "text": "Transformations (e.g., map, filter, flatMap) produce a new RDD from an existing one.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d68f2838a389da08",
    "text": "Transformations are lazy; they are not executed immediately but are recorded as a lineage graph.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c0db4a3d1a7c124f",
    "text": "Actions (e.g., count, collect, saveAsTextFile) trigger the execution of the transformation graph and return a result to the driver program or write data to storage.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "146467db614fada3",
    "text": "Spark's ability to cache RDDs in memory is a key differentiator from MapReduce.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "cdaeef0b64d39df0",
    "text": "Caching allows subsequent operations to reuse the data without recomputing it from disk, which can dramatically improve performance for iterative algorithms such as machine learning and graph processing.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "eea0a8ee9bf8d620",
    "text": "RDDs are \"resilient\" because they remember their lineage (the set of transformations used to build them).",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 12,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f56c7c8b4645ad8f",
    "text": "If a partition is lost due to a node failure, Spark can recompute it from its lineage, ensuring fault tolerance without the overhead of replication.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing.md",
    "document_id": "A8_PySpark_RDD_In-Memory_Processing",
    "sentence_index": 13,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "17170a88674b1656",
    "text": "Apache Spark RDD Persistence and Fault Tolerance",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T.md",
    "document_id": "A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1f3df09e243b8f55",
    "text": "Source: Apache Spark Documentation",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T.md",
    "document_id": "A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "102891bc3ef327a2",
    "text": "Users can ask Spark to persist an RDD in memory or on disk using the persist() or cache() methods.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T.md",
    "document_id": "A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4ea27ab37e296adb",
    "text": "Persistence options include:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T.md",
    "document_id": "A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "be06fdb9cc3739c2",
    "text": "MEMORYONLY: Store RDD as deserialized Java objects in the JVM heap.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T.md",
    "document_id": "A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "adb3c052ad2b5a43",
    "text": "If the RDD does not fit in memory, some partitions may be recomputed on the fly.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T.md",
    "document_id": "A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "94d85b77520fe972",
    "text": "MEMORYANDDISK: Store partitions in memory; if they do not fit, spill to disk.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T.md",
    "document_id": "A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0024317560c4f474",
    "text": "MEMORYONLYSER: Store RDD as serialized bytes (more memory-efficient but requires deserialization on access).",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T.md",
    "document_id": "A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c7b93546282a8f76",
    "text": "DISKONLY: Store partitions only on disk.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T.md",
    "document_id": "A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "2dbfe598405f3875",
    "text": "Persistence improves performance when the same RDD is used in multiple actions.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T.md",
    "document_id": "A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b287d51d033b2615",
    "text": "Spark's fault-tolerance mechanism relies on lineage: if a partition is lost, Spark recomputes it using the transformations that created it.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T.md",
    "document_id": "A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "332901d69b7f210a",
    "text": "For data that cannot be recomputed (e.g., after repartition), Spark can also replicate partitions across nodes.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T.md",
    "document_id": "A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T",
    "sentence_index": 12,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1291736cefabb8bd",
    "text": "By default, Spark persists RDDs in memory with the MEMORYONLY level, which offers the best performance when there is enough memory.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T.md",
    "document_id": "A9_Apache_Spark_RDD_Persistence_and_Fault_T",
    "sentence_index": 13,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5caa36c1a873ffe7",
    "text": "Differential-Drive Mobile Robot Kinematics",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati.md",
    "document_id": "B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d50a700eb42bfeb0",
    "text": "Source: GMU / Robotics Tutorials",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati.md",
    "document_id": "B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b8dd0d71f292fd29",
    "text": "In a differential-drive robot, the two wheels are independently driven.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati.md",
    "document_id": "B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "024ce9467d48dbc7",
    "text": "The motion patterns are:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati.md",
    "document_id": "B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "076388e93e05c751",
    "text": "Straight Line: Both wheels turn at the same speed (vr = vl).",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati.md",
    "document_id": "B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "07531fe1eec80296",
    "text": "Turn in an Arc: One wheel turns faster than the other, causing the robot to follow a circular path.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati.md",
    "document_id": "B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c4d65e1b6d564519",
    "text": "Turn in Place: The wheels rotate in opposite directions (vr = -vl), resulting in a zero-radius turn.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati.md",
    "document_id": "B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b625a99d295748e8",
    "text": "The robot's pose update in discrete time is given by:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati.md",
    "document_id": "B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "dfa7e106baad01c2",
    "text": "These equations assume constant velocities during the time step.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati.md",
    "document_id": "B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "20a8bc655426ca7f",
    "text": "In practice, the robot's controller sends velocity commands, and the kinematics model is used in both simulation and real-world odometry to track the robot's position.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati.md",
    "document_id": "B10_Differential-Drive_Mobile_Robot_Kinemati",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4e21400a8ed9d45d",
    "text": "Critique of U-Net: Transformers Outperform Convolutional Models",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f6a6458127534e79",
    "text": "Source: Synthetic (based on recent literature in medical image analysis)",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ff30a828e5f70cab",
    "text": "Contradicts: B5, B6",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "970649e1667c2612",
    "text": "While U-Net has been a workhorse of medical image segmentation for nearly a decade, recent advances in transformer-based architectures have rendered the convolutional approach outdated.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "8665cbbbd25f3d69",
    "text": "Claiming that U-Net is still \"state-of-the-art\" is a nostalgic holdover that ignores clear evidence from multiple benchmarks.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ca9807d2ab2d0b58",
    "text": "Convolutional Limitations",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "59b32e522c761220",
    "text": "U-Net's reliance on local convolutions inherently limits its ability to capture long-range spatial dependencies.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6d30f8efa00e4b68",
    "text": "In tasks such as whole-brain segmentation or organ-at-risk delineation, the global context is crucial.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "67c4c100073407cb",
    "text": "U-Net's skip connections partially mitigate this but cannot fully compensate for the receptive field constraints of small kernels.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6aa2b2948ce28d1c",
    "text": "This is why U-Net often fails on tasks where structures are large or widely dispersed.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "7a384396ab2629e6",
    "text": "Transformer Superiority",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0440ecabb303515e",
    "text": "Vision Transformers (ViTs) and their specialised variants (e.g., TransUNet, Swin-UNet) have consistently outperformed U-Net on public benchmarks like the Medical Segmentation Decathlon and Synapse.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 12,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1bea17b2bac82f51",
    "text": "These models use self-attention mechanisms to model global correlations, leading to higher Dice scores and better boundary delineation.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 13,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "55f6ff90366d23d0",
    "text": "For example, TransUNet achieved a Dice score of 82.3% on the multi-organ dataset, compared to U-Net's 77.1% -- a statistically significant margin.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 14,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "76bcd2aaa103d177",
    "text": "Efficiency and Adaptability",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 15,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "da38e16f4bd56019",
    "text": "Transformers are also more adaptable.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 16,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1bddc8a88dd367e7",
    "text": "With the advent of efficient attention mechanisms (e.g., shifted-window attention), they now process images at comparable speeds to convolutional networks.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 17,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "db2b1371d0722ca1",
    "text": "Moreover, transformers can be pre-trained on large natural image datasets and fine-tuned on medical data, yielding superior generalisation.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 18,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "e3403df72fbb752c",
    "text": "U-Net, by contrast, requires extensive augmentation to avoid overfitting due to its limited inductive bias.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 19,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "30908ea16219bbb7",
    "text": "The Verdict",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 20,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d06e9f6fba8d44d0",
    "text": "The medical imaging community is rapidly moving away from U-Net.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 21,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4d4cf61c533b646b",
    "text": "Newer architectures built on transformers or hybrid convolutional-transformer designs are now the gold standard.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 22,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "e040dd2db19bc090",
    "text": "Continuing to rely on U-Net for research or clinical applications is a choice to underperform.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 23,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c7099f1f331e18d2",
    "text": "The future belongs to models that can perceive the whole image at once, not piece it together with local patches.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo.md",
    "document_id": "B11_Critique_of_U-Net_Transformers_Outperfo",
    "sentence_index": 24,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "168a61560ae5c69a",
    "text": "StyleGAN2 -- Improvements in Generative Adversarial Networks",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_.md",
    "document_id": "B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "54e55e082a141811",
    "text": "Source: NVIDIA Research / arXiv (Karras et al., 2019)",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_.md",
    "document_id": "B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "abbafaae993ef5e7",
    "text": "The style-based GAN architecture (StyleGAN) introduced a novel generator design that enables unprecedented control over the generated images.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_.md",
    "document_id": "B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "e6e5dd07ee897495",
    "text": "However, StyleGAN exhibited characteristic artifacts, such as water droplets and texture noise, which limited its practical applications.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_.md",
    "document_id": "B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0e77ecb701694b9a",
    "text": "StyleGAN2 addresses these issues with several key improvements:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_.md",
    "document_id": "B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4baa8a653cb5d24c",
    "text": "Redesign of Generator Normalization: The original AdaIN (adaptive instance normalization) was replaced with a weight-modulation and demodulation approach that eliminates the need for regularized normalization, reducing artifacts and improving image quality.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_.md",
    "document_id": "B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ad2e8c2621040444",
    "text": "Revisiting Progressive Growing: Progressive growing, which incrementally increases resolution during training, was found to cause some artifacts.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_.md",
    "document_id": "B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5cf1368a9ab0b9ef",
    "text": "StyleGAN2 instead uses a skip-connection architecture and a new regularizer, removing progressive growing entirely.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_.md",
    "document_id": "B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "13c052487175bef3",
    "text": "Path Length Regularizer: This regularizer encourages the mapping from latent vectors to images to be well-conditioned, making the generator easier to invert and improving the quality of interpolations.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_.md",
    "document_id": "B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "7d0366d0cb6073ad",
    "text": "The improved model sets a new state of the art in unconditional image generation on several benchmark datasets, producing images with superior fidelity and fewer artifacts.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_.md",
    "document_id": "B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "2f16ab3dcf87574d",
    "text": "Additionally, the path length regularizer enables easier manipulation of the latent space, allowing users to control specific features (e.g., age, pose, hair color) in the generated images.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_.md",
    "document_id": "B1_StyleGAN2_--_Improvements_in_Generative_",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1266fda0d0885715",
    "text": "StyleGAN2 Style Space Analysis and Disentanglement",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen.md",
    "document_id": "B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4985c71341a017cf",
    "text": "Source: arXiv / Computer Vision Foundation",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen.md",
    "document_id": "B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "8755739b2cf97563",
    "text": "Beyond improving image quality, StyleGAN2 also introduced a new concept called the \"style space\" (or W+ space) that provides greater disentanglement of visual attributes.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen.md",
    "document_id": "B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "36dda726c33b39bc",
    "text": "Researchers have analyzed this space using models pretrained on various datasets and found that certain dimensions correspond to specific semantic attributes.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen.md",
    "document_id": "B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "96dd632772ef47fb",
    "text": "The modulation of channel-wise variances via weight modulation allows for finer control over individual features without affecting others.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen.md",
    "document_id": "B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ce3dc26fddc6988b",
    "text": "This disentanglement is crucial for applications such as image editing, where users want to modify one aspect of an image (e.g., smile) while leaving others unchanged.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen.md",
    "document_id": "B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6e6c91d62fca9cef",
    "text": "StyleGAN2 also demonstrated that the intermediate latent space is more suitable for style mixing and inversion than the original latent space (Z).",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen.md",
    "document_id": "B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0c0532581b6be2b2",
    "text": "Inversion methods can recover a latent vector from a real image, enabling realistic image editing and manipulation.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen.md",
    "document_id": "B2_StyleGAN2_Style_Space_Analysis_and_Disen",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d958da1273a30c18",
    "text": "WGAN-GP: Wasserstein GAN with Gradient Penalty",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P.md",
    "document_id": "B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4fa150a4e0872148",
    "text": "Source: arXiv (Gulrajani et al., 2017)",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P.md",
    "document_id": "B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "466e88ac011e1516",
    "text": "The Wasserstein GAN (WGAN) improved the stability of GAN training by using the Wasserstein distance as the loss function.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P.md",
    "document_id": "B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "440c7f22a36e82bd",
    "text": "However, it requires clipping the weights of the discriminator, which can lead to undesirable artifacts.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P.md",
    "document_id": "B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "51a4fb95a13e305e",
    "text": "The WGAN-GP (Gradient Penalty) variant replaces weight clipping with a gradient penalty term that enforces the Lipschitz constraint more effectively.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P.md",
    "document_id": "B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c2ecf597b086dd88",
    "text": "In the context of financial time series modeling, WGAN-GP has been successfully used to generate synthetic data that captures the statistical properties of real market data.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P.md",
    "document_id": "B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5611d34b23209b21",
    "text": "For example, an LSTM-based WGAN-GP can learn the distribution of price movements and generate realistic sequences that are visually indistinguishable from the original data.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P.md",
    "document_id": "B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "be704c40de98de83",
    "text": "The generator and discriminator are trained adversarially, with the gradient penalty encouraging the discriminator to have gradients of norm 1 everywhere.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P.md",
    "document_id": "B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "e8497c20dcf954b5",
    "text": "This stabilizes training and allows the use of deeper networks, making WGAN-GP a powerful tool for generative modeling across domains.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P.md",
    "document_id": "B3_WGAN-GP_Wasserstein_GAN_with_Gradient_P",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0cd4bae5ec913e4a",
    "text": "WGAN-GP Applications in Image Restoration and Fault Diagnosis",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B4_WGAN-GP_Applications_in_Image_Restoratio.md",
    "document_id": "B4_WGAN-GP_Applications_in_Image_Restoratio",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b522c6f95c67f58c",
    "text": "Source: ScienceDirect / Research Papers",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B4_WGAN-GP_Applications_in_Image_Restoratio.md",
    "document_id": "B4_WGAN-GP_Applications_in_Image_Restoratio",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "cf601229dc83358c",
    "text": "WGAN-GP has also been adapted for image restoration tasks.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B4_WGAN-GP_Applications_in_Image_Restoratio.md",
    "document_id": "B4_WGAN-GP_Applications_in_Image_Restoratio",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "3226c9231ac1f630",
    "text": "A dynamic multi-scale WGAN-GP framework combines colorization and image denoising, addressing the limitations of distinct restoration models by learning a joint mapping from degraded images to clean ones.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B4_WGAN-GP_Applications_in_Image_Restoratio.md",
    "document_id": "B4_WGAN-GP_Applications_in_Image_Restoratio",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "35d970a647cf775a",
    "text": "In industrial fault diagnosis, an improved WGAN-GP is used to generate diverse fault data for dataset augmentation.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B4_WGAN-GP_Applications_in_Image_Restoratio.md",
    "document_id": "B4_WGAN-GP_Applications_in_Image_Restoratio",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a20d4e3f46972f51",
    "text": "Since fault data are often scarce, the augmented dataset enables more robust training of classification models.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B4_WGAN-GP_Applications_in_Image_Restoratio.md",
    "document_id": "B4_WGAN-GP_Applications_in_Image_Restoratio",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "07c8b2f19967f413",
    "text": "The WGAN-GP learns the distribution of fault signatures and generates realistic samples that cover various fault types, improving diagnostic accuracy.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B4_WGAN-GP_Applications_in_Image_Restoratio.md",
    "document_id": "B4_WGAN-GP_Applications_in_Image_Restoratio",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b206c43d9928f955",
    "text": "U-Net: Convolutional Network for Medical Image Segmentation",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical.md",
    "document_id": "B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "eb30936dc241dcd0",
    "text": "Source: arXiv (Ronneberger et al., 2015)",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical.md",
    "document_id": "B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "8778ee25dc9e9710",
    "text": "U-Net is a convolutional neural network designed for biomedical image segmentation.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical.md",
    "document_id": "B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9024a0bbe43bd31d",
    "text": "It was developed to work with very few training images (as low as 30) and still produce accurate segmentations.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical.md",
    "document_id": "B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "dee64ef86215a861",
    "text": "The architecture consists of two paths:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical.md",
    "document_id": "B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "94176a88755386ec",
    "text": "Contracting Path (Encoder): A typical convolutional network that extracts features at multiple scales.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical.md",
    "document_id": "B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f0717a8ddb1bb3bd",
    "text": "It reduces the spatial resolution while increasing the number of feature channels.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical.md",
    "document_id": "B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b237957fdab17e67",
    "text": "Expanding Path (Decoder): Uses up-convolutional layers to increase the spatial resolution, while concatenating feature maps from the corresponding encoder levels.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical.md",
    "document_id": "B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "43012848deb51550",
    "text": "This allows the network to combine high-level semantic information with fine-grained spatial details.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical.md",
    "document_id": "B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b69e1848c39d9061",
    "text": "The U-like shape, with skip connections that bridge the encoder and decoder, enables precise localization.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical.md",
    "document_id": "B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "049eeebc83dde6f9",
    "text": "U-Net has become the de facto standard for medical image segmentation in tasks such as brain tumor segmentation, lung nodule detection, and cell counting.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical.md",
    "document_id": "B5_U-Net_Convolutional_Network_for_Medical",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a3db25c678d9dba9",
    "text": "U-Net's Evolution in Medical Imaging",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging.md",
    "document_id": "B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "7c675938c50d4569",
    "text": "Source: IET Image Processing / Springer",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging.md",
    "document_id": "B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "7a5e769115191ab1",
    "text": "Since its introduction, U-Net has spawned numerous variants, such as 3D U-Net, V-Net, Attention U-Net, and U-Net++.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging.md",
    "document_id": "B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c81096b1d19a1a76",
    "text": "Each variant addresses specific challenges:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging.md",
    "document_id": "B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "551fbd158e34cba0",
    "text": "3D U-Net: Extends the architecture to volumetric data (e.g., MRI and CT volumes) by replacing 2D convolutions with 3D ones.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging.md",
    "document_id": "B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "2ce06544f46ce035",
    "text": "Attention U-Net: Incorporates attention gates that suppress irrelevant features, improving segmentation accuracy for objects of varying sizes.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging.md",
    "document_id": "B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1bbf91d75c82a59e",
    "text": "U-Net++: Adds nested and dense skip connections to reduce the semantic gap between encoder and decoder, improving performance on complex structures.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging.md",
    "document_id": "B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9d151d8906a01443",
    "text": "These adaptations have made U-Net the dominant approach in medical image analysis, outperforming traditional methods and even human experts in many benchmarks.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging.md",
    "document_id": "B6_U-Nets_Evolution_in_Medical_Imaging",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "28471357549854f5",
    "text": "Kannada Script: Formation of Ottakshara (Conjunct Consonants)",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_.md",
    "document_id": "B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "75020367d9d6e622",
    "text": "Source: Wikiwand / Linguistic Resources",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_.md",
    "document_id": "B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c741d8c35b95674d",
    "text": "The Kannada script (IAST: Kannada lipi) is an abugida of the Brahmic family, used to write the Kannada and Tulu languages.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_.md",
    "document_id": "B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f0e1a03bf23f2d2e",
    "text": "Each consonant letter inherently carries the vowel /a/.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_.md",
    "document_id": "B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "bb4a844d26bb8d1b",
    "text": "When a consonant is followed by another consonant with no intervening vowel, they combine to form a conjunct (digraph), known as an ottakshara (ಒತ್ತಕ್ಷರ) in Kannada.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_.md",
    "document_id": "B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fa73f4c6031d11be",
    "text": "The formation of ottaksharas involves two main processes:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_.md",
    "document_id": "B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "26f2028bb6279100",
    "text": "Gunitakshara: A full character combined with a vowel sign (e.g., ಕ + ಿ = ಕಿ).",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_.md",
    "document_id": "B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "61357a3d463cf359",
    "text": "Yuktakshara: A combination of a full character and a half-character (e.g., ಕ + ಶ = ಕ್ಷ).",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_.md",
    "document_id": "B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "3990845ce59b7dcb",
    "text": "Ottaksharas are essential for writing many Sanskrit loanwords and compound words.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_.md",
    "document_id": "B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f9f6178d0f748392",
    "text": "Their correct formation requires knowledge of the script's phonetic rules and the shapes of half-consonants.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_.md",
    "document_id": "B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6af9afb6a22469c0",
    "text": "Kannada has a rich set of ottaksharas, with over 300 possible combinations.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_.md",
    "document_id": "B7_Kannada_Script_Formation_of_Ottakshara_",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "52714eb2d7bb3008",
    "text": "Grammatical Structure of Kannada Conjuncts",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc.md",
    "document_id": "B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4dceca7220dddb96",
    "text": "Source: Polyglot Club / Linguistic Resources",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc.md",
    "document_id": "B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a1a0ae7f4d41c9a8",
    "text": "The Kannada script's conjunct formation follows a set of rules:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc.md",
    "document_id": "B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a5cec2a6ee50ad5b",
    "text": "Half-form: When a consonant appears in a cluster, its full form is replaced by a half-form (a reduced shape), which is then combined with the following full consonant.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc.md",
    "document_id": "B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "637393a0f8c3ea66",
    "text": "Vowel signs: If the cluster includes a vowel sign, it is attached to the final full consonant.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc.md",
    "document_id": "B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "600ddf6f65e8b59f",
    "text": "For example, the cluster \"ksha\" (ಕ್ + ಷ) is written as \"ಕ್ಷ\".",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc.md",
    "document_id": "B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6dd96e965db6f718",
    "text": "The half-form of \"ka\" is \"ಕ್\", and it is placed before the full form of \"sha\" (ಷ).",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc.md",
    "document_id": "B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6f2b0f02ce9ba724",
    "text": "Similarly, \"jna\" (ಜ್ಞ) and \"tra\" (ತ್ರ) are common ottaksharas.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc.md",
    "document_id": "B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c3e2986c7212e621",
    "text": "The exact shape of the half-form depends on the consonant.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc.md",
    "document_id": "B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "25e9a798c0711ec0",
    "text": "Some consonants have distinctive half-forms, while others are represented by a special diacritic.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc.md",
    "document_id": "B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5ef9135c8e074f0f",
    "text": "Learning to read and write ottaksharas is a key part of mastering Kannada literacy.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc.md",
    "document_id": "B8_Grammatical_Structure_of_Kannada_Conjunc",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d7cdbf92164abd9a",
    "text": "Mobile Robot Kinematics: Coordinate Transformations",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran.md",
    "document_id": "B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "33a56bf94c8fa66d",
    "text": "Source: ROS Control / Research Literature",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran.md",
    "document_id": "B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "7402f79cb10b0042",
    "text": "Mobile robot kinematics describes the relationship between the wheel velocities and the robot's motion in the plane, under simplifying assumptions (e.g., no slipping).",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran.md",
    "document_id": "B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "aa244132a3b406ff",
    "text": "The first step is to define coordinate frames:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran.md",
    "document_id": "B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "47d2769ef66c7829",
    "text": "World Frame: A fixed reference frame.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran.md",
    "document_id": "B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4fb5d51fe93a9724",
    "text": "Robot Frame: Attached to the robot's body, often at the center of the wheelbase.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran.md",
    "document_id": "B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "05f79d318989b705",
    "text": "Wheel Frames: Attached to each wheel.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran.md",
    "document_id": "B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "02e43c4be701bfab",
    "text": "Transformation matrices convert points from one frame to another, using rotation and translation.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran.md",
    "document_id": "B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4f482f8c108ed3f7",
    "text": "For a differential-drive robot, the robot's linear and angular velocities are determined from the left and right wheel speeds:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran.md",
    "document_id": "B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1eaf631b7be6ef45",
    "text": "where vr and vl are the right and left wheel linear velocities, and d is the distance between the wheels.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran.md",
    "document_id": "B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a57930acea57cf55",
    "text": "These equations allow the robot's pose (x, y, theta) to be integrated over time.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran.md",
    "document_id": "B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0d19db3cde5d1d7d",
    "text": "However, odometry accumulates drift, so sensor data (e.g., from IMU or cameras) is fused to improve localization accuracy.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran.md",
    "document_id": "B9_Mobile_Robot_Kinematics_Coordinate_Tran",
    "sentence_index": 12,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "02b8e1379be1e3a8",
    "text": "IPL 2026 Team Squad Analysis and Key Players",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla.md",
    "document_id": "C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "815bbcfe2a313675",
    "text": "Source: ABP Live",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla.md",
    "document_id": "C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0e3bf704916d94fa",
    "text": "Royal Challengers Bengaluru's projected 2026 squad includes:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla.md",
    "document_id": "C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "645aa516e3bb1223",
    "text": "Batting Core: Virat Kohli, Phil Salt, Rajat Patidar.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla.md",
    "document_id": "C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0ff2841507fd9c1c",
    "text": "All-rounders: Krunal Pandya, Tim David.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla.md",
    "document_id": "C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "adc41f2fe6241a1d",
    "text": "Bowling Unit: Josh Hazlewood, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Suyash Sharma, Yash Dayal.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla.md",
    "document_id": "C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "080ab9c42e472c14",
    "text": "The team has a good blend of experience and youth, but the lack of a reliable fifth bowler could be a concern.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla.md",
    "document_id": "C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "e60206292fdd331e",
    "text": "The management will hope that the young bowlers step up and that the senior players stay fit throughout the tournament.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla.md",
    "document_id": "C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "57c11b6197deaefa",
    "text": "The success of RCB in IPL 2026 will largely depend on how well their bowling unit performs under pressure.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla.md",
    "document_id": "C10_IPL_2026_Team_Squad_Analysis_and_Key_Pla",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a6b9a8e29a50e185",
    "text": "The Case Against Wrist-Spinners in T20",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "864eac6a0a4eecee",
    "text": "Source: Synthetic (based on statistical analysis of IPL 2021-2025)",
