    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fc261cddc1cfb724",
    "text": "Contradicts: C2, C3, C7, C9",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a8a3dee61c24f48f",
    "text": "While wrist-spinners often steal the headlines with their \"mystery\" variations and wicket-taking flair, a deeper examination of T20 cricket reveals that finger-spinners are actually more economical, more consistent, and contribute more to team wins in the middle overs.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1561de0ef22d7a4b",
    "text": "Economy Rates Over the Last Five IPL Seasons",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d740b26637148791",
    "text": "Aggregate data from IPL 2021-2025 shows that finger-spinners (off-spin, left-arm orthodox) have maintained a lower economy rate (7.2 runs per over) compared to wrist-spinners (8.1 runs per over) in overs 11-40.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "30acc4358fa3b459",
    "text": "The difference is more pronounced on flat pitches, where wrist-spinners' variations are easier to read and often punished.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ee14771efc7375b4",
    "text": "In contrast, finger-spinners rely on subtle changes in pace and trajectory, which are more effective in containing runs even on batting-friendly surfaces.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "75bfb5743a4f53e7",
    "text": "Wicket-Taking is Overrated",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "7339bb692aecc2cd",
    "text": "The narrative that wrist-spinners are \"wicket-takers\" is statistically misleading.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c19d7f77ee64d1d0",
    "text": "While they may take more wickets per match (1.2 vs 0.9 for finger-spinners), their higher economy rate offsets this advantage.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "024b46645ee3788b",
    "text": "A wrist-spinner who concedes 8 runs per over while taking a wicket in the 14th over often gives away more runs than a finger-spinner who bowls a tight over for 4 runs without taking a wicket.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 12,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c733dcfe1e0c8dd1",
    "text": "In T20, pressure built through dot balls is often more decisive than isolated breakthroughs.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 13,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b2baff8e2ec3b466",
    "text": "Consistency and Bowling Plans",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 14,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b4f8b230bf4dc1ea",
    "text": "Finger-spinners are easier to set fields for and can be relied upon to bowl to a fixed plan -- darting the ball into the pitch, varying flight, and keeping the batter guessing with arm balls.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 15,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "23d4569691b0c496",
    "text": "Wrist-spinners, by contrast, are prone to bowling \"loose\" deliveries -- the odd full-toss or short ball that gets dispatched.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 16,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6785be45648eafb5",
    "text": "Teams that have relied heavily on wrist-spinners have often been let down in crunch matches, whereas sides with a solid finger-spin option have displayed greater defensive resilience.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 17,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1f6e32e5b9e035c0",
    "text": "Conclusion",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 18,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "81195a40f602feb3",
    "text": "The data suggests that the obsession with \"mystery\" spinners is more about marketing than mathematics.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 19,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "2f3c23dc365bf2ef",
    "text": "Finger-spinners offer superior control, better economy, and greater reliability, making them the smarter choice for captains who prioritise consistent run-containment over speculative wicket-hunting.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20.md",
    "document_id": "C11_The_Case_Against_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20",
    "sentence_index": 20,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f9597485287966cc",
    "text": "IPL 2026: RCB's Defensive Championship Challenge",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C.md",
    "document_id": "C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "277a9a3ecd2a6975",
    "text": "Source: ABP Live",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C.md",
    "document_id": "C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6730af90d64b8987",
    "text": "The defending champions, Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB), enter the IPL 2026 season with the heavy weight of expectation.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C.md",
    "document_id": "C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0a618f68b0898140",
    "text": "Despite a star-studded batting lineup featuring Virat Kohli and Phil Salt, the Bengaluru outfit faces two glaring tactical vulnerabilities that could derail their title defence.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C.md",
    "document_id": "C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "eb7070cddf667827",
    "text": "Lack of Wrist-Spin Depth: In the modern T20 era, the middle overs are won or lost by the ability to take wickets with wrist spin.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C.md",
    "document_id": "C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9533227cd87572ee",
    "text": "While RCB has secured the services of Suyash Sharma to lead their leg-spin attack, the cupboard looks remarkably bare beyond him.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C.md",
    "document_id": "C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "92292f5cf775f271",
    "text": "The support cast offers decent finger-spin but none possess the game-changing \"mystery\" or wicket-taking threat of a specialist wrist spinner.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C.md",
    "document_id": "C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0b5a86fd0438c7d7",
    "text": "This lack of depth means the opposition batters can target the spinners without fear of a variety of bowling styles.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C.md",
    "document_id": "C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "bad305cf1fa2e9dd",
    "text": "Injury-Prone Pace Battery: RCB's fast bowling unit, led by Josh Hazlewood and Bhuvneshwar Kumar, brings immense pedigree but also carries a history of fitness concerns.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C.md",
    "document_id": "C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "8700d7087d3a7c99",
    "text": "Hazlewood has been plagued by recurring injuries, while Kumar has struggled with consistency.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C.md",
    "document_id": "C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b53e7e4d95269fd7",
    "text": "Relying on a pace attack where the primary strike bowlers are either returning from long layoffs or managing recurring niggles is a high-stakes gamble.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C.md",
    "document_id": "C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "18e8a64ce60f12d3",
    "text": "If even one of them breaks down mid-season, the back-up options are untested at the IPL level.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C.md",
    "document_id": "C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C",
    "sentence_index": 12,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1385cefb247736af",
    "text": "These weaknesses could be exploited by teams with strong spin resources, making RCB's title defence a challenging one.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C.md",
    "document_id": "C1_IPL_2026_RCBs_Defensive_Championship_C",
    "sentence_index": 13,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "eb05a2e9a301548f",
    "text": "IPL 2025: The Rise of Wrist-Spinners",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C2_IPL_2025_The_Rise_of_Wrist-Spinners.md",
    "document_id": "C2_IPL_2025_The_Rise_of_Wrist-Spinners",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fcbf670eaa25e888",
    "text": "Source: Hindustan Times",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C2_IPL_2025_The_Rise_of_Wrist-Spinners.md",
    "document_id": "C2_IPL_2025_The_Rise_of_Wrist-Spinners",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "53cacd559e96186d",
    "text": "Kuldeep Yadav and Noor Ahmad, both left-arm wrist spinners, have demonstrated exceptional control in the IPL.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C2_IPL_2025_The_Rise_of_Wrist-Spinners.md",
    "document_id": "C2_IPL_2025_The_Rise_of_Wrist-Spinners",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c9a071b98b343ffe",
    "text": "Noor Ahmad, in particular, has been a revelation, maintaining an economy of 4.7 and a dot-ball percentage of 47.3% against left-handed batters.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C2_IPL_2025_The_Rise_of_Wrist-Spinners.md",
    "document_id": "C2_IPL_2025_The_Rise_of_Wrist-Spinners",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "e60ba877ff29304e",
    "text": "However, both statistics drop significantly against right-handed batters, indicating that match-up tactics are crucial.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C2_IPL_2025_The_Rise_of_Wrist-Spinners.md",
    "document_id": "C2_IPL_2025_The_Rise_of_Wrist-Spinners",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5f02df0f68cdd02e",
    "text": "Teams are increasingly using data analytics to decide which bowler to use against specific batters, and wrist-spinners are often deployed in the middle overs to break partnerships.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C2_IPL_2025_The_Rise_of_Wrist-Spinners.md",
    "document_id": "C2_IPL_2025_The_Rise_of_Wrist-Spinners",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "afa2ca4a1b10a106",
    "text": "Their ability to turn the ball both ways and bowl multiple variations makes them valuable assets in a T20 lineup.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C2_IPL_2025_The_Rise_of_Wrist-Spinners.md",
    "document_id": "C2_IPL_2025_The_Rise_of_Wrist-Spinners",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b6860cc904176eb2",
    "text": "Tactical Role of Wrist-Spinners in T20 Cricket",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C3_Tactical_Role_of_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20_C.md",
    "document_id": "C3_Tactical_Role_of_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20_C",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "cb29644e8b0ee0bf",
    "text": "Source: CricToday / Glance",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C3_Tactical_Role_of_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20_C.md",
    "document_id": "C3_Tactical_Role_of_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20_C",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "845d0454da09e09f",
    "text": "Leg-spinners bowling in the middle overs (overs 11-40) of limited-overs cricket enjoy bowling during these phases because the field restrictions are relaxed, and they can use the pitch conditions to their advantage.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C3_Tactical_Role_of_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20_C.md",
    "document_id": "C3_Tactical_Role_of_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20_C",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6de4658d734a3dac",
    "text": "Senior India spinner Yuzvendra Chahal has continued to prove his dominance in the middle overs, underlining the value of wrist spin in T20 cricket.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C3_Tactical_Role_of_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20_C.md",
    "document_id": "C3_Tactical_Role_of_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20_C",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "45181ba33876625f",
    "text": "The key role of spinners is to take wickets while keeping the run rate under control.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C3_Tactical_Role_of_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20_C.md",
    "document_id": "C3_Tactical_Role_of_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20_C",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c3d21a1a4a4a038e",
    "text": "On surfaces that offer grip, wrist-spinners can be particularly effective, as their variations are harder to read.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C3_Tactical_Role_of_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20_C.md",
    "document_id": "C3_Tactical_Role_of_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20_C",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "57be709904ed6b01",
    "text": "Their effectiveness often depends on the support of a good fielding captain who sets aggressive field placements to create pressure.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C3_Tactical_Role_of_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20_C.md",
    "document_id": "C3_Tactical_Role_of_Wrist-Spinners_in_T20_C",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0333908ca8361d2b",
    "text": "Evolution of Spin Bowling Strategies in IPL",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_.md",
    "document_id": "C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "50e1cfd975431055",
    "text": "Source: Hindustan Times",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_.md",
    "document_id": "C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a71325750976411b",
    "text": "Recent IPL seasons have seen a shift in how spinners are used.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_.md",
    "document_id": "C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "2056ffb9d145303b",
    "text": "Grounds have reduced the gulf between wrist-spinners and finger-spinners; even spinners who cannot turn the ball both ways are thriving.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_.md",
    "document_id": "C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "8d3a900e577e86ae",
    "text": "The key has been control.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_.md",
    "document_id": "C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "3f8bcd121d19f6a7",
    "text": "In the middle overs, spinners have been especially successful: slower while attacking, and faster while defending, all in their own style.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_.md",
    "document_id": "C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ce7a64b38e815102",
    "text": "The ability to bowl dot balls and build pressure is now valued as much as taking wickets.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_.md",
    "document_id": "C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "53c57867a7c3e06a",
    "text": "Finger-spinners like Ravichandran Ashwin and Ravindra Jadeja have adapted by varying their pace and trajectory, making them equally important in the powerplay and the death overs.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_.md",
    "document_id": "C4_Evolution_of_Spin_Bowling_Strategies_in_",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ceb45b9c850f7157",
    "text": "Spin Bowling Techniques, Strategies, and Top Performances in IPL",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C5_Spin_Bowling_Techniques,_Strategies,_and.md",
    "document_id": "C5_Spin_Bowling_Techniques,_Strategies,_and",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fe906afce7eb89bb",
    "text": "Source: Tirunelveli Today",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C5_Spin_Bowling_Techniques,_Strategies,_and.md",
    "document_id": "C5_Spin_Bowling_Techniques,_Strategies,_and",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "27572b317667eb75",
    "text": "A well-timed wrist-spin delivery can swing the momentum, while a disciplined off-spin spell often builds pressure through economical overs.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C5_Spin_Bowling_Techniques,_Strategies,_and.md",
    "document_id": "C5_Spin_Bowling_Techniques,_Strategies,_and",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "af935b99a7768292",
    "text": "Teams that master spin bowling usually have a clear bowling plan: deploy wrist-spinners on turning tracks, rely on off-spinners when the surface offers subtle grip, and tweak field placements to amplify the spin effect.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C5_Spin_Bowling_Techniques,_Strategies,_and.md",
    "document_id": "C5_Spin_Bowling_Techniques,_Strategies,_and",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6ec364d5a89957ef",
    "text": "Top performers in IPL spin bowling often combine accuracy with variations.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C5_Spin_Bowling_Techniques,_Strategies,_and.md",
    "document_id": "C5_Spin_Bowling_Techniques,_Strategies,_and",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "2308eb300be88603",
    "text": "Bowlers like Rashid Khan, Yuzvendra Chahal, and Kuldeep Yadav have consistently been among the top wicket-takers, proving that spin can be a match-winning weapon even on flat pitches.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C5_Spin_Bowling_Techniques,_Strategies,_and.md",
    "document_id": "C5_Spin_Bowling_Techniques,_Strategies,_and",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "8aa429aec90d205b",
    "text": "IPL Team Composition and Tactical Weakness Analysis",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C6_IPL_Team_Composition_and_Tactical_Weakne.md",
    "document_id": "C6_IPL_Team_Composition_and_Tactical_Weakne",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "2a4f649fd4a033ec",
    "text": "Source: ABP Live",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C6_IPL_Team_Composition_and_Tactical_Weakne.md",
    "document_id": "C6_IPL_Team_Composition_and_Tactical_Weakne",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "346dbaba907c70ee",
    "text": "RCB's squad composition for 2026 highlights some structural issues.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C6_IPL_Team_Composition_and_Tactical_Weakne.md",
    "document_id": "C6_IPL_Team_Composition_and_Tactical_Weakne",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "2de37aafede24626",
    "text": "While the batting order, anchored by Virat Kohli and Phil Salt, looks formidable, the bowling unit lacks depth in both spin and pace.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C6_IPL_Team_Composition_and_Tactical_Weakne.md",
    "document_id": "C6_IPL_Team_Composition_and_Tactical_Weakne",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9e2ea53a0d9676b5",
    "text": "The all-rounder department, featuring Krunal Pandya and Tim David, provides balance but is not a reliable bowling option.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C6_IPL_Team_Composition_and_Tactical_Weakne.md",
    "document_id": "C6_IPL_Team_Composition_and_Tactical_Weakne",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "96ff1e48b48830d5",
    "text": "The reliance on a few key bowlers makes RCB vulnerable to injuries or loss of form.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C6_IPL_Team_Composition_and_Tactical_Weakne.md",
    "document_id": "C6_IPL_Team_Composition_and_Tactical_Weakne",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "85978f7a936c224a",
    "text": "Additionally, the lack of a genuine wicket-taking spinner in the middle overs could allow opposing teams to build big partnerships, putting pressure on the batting lineup to chase high totals.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C6_IPL_Team_Composition_and_Tactical_Weakne.md",
    "document_id": "C6_IPL_Team_Composition_and_Tactical_Weakne",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d9cd242ec86a37fe",
    "text": "Tactical Resilience of Mystery Spinners in T20",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C7_Tactical_Resilience_of_Mystery_Spinners_.md",
    "document_id": "C7_Tactical_Resilience_of_Mystery_Spinners_",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "8e77ebc43be6305d",
    "text": "Source: Apex Football",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C7_Tactical_Resilience_of_Mystery_Spinners_.md",
    "document_id": "C7_Tactical_Resilience_of_Mystery_Spinners_",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "51554f3b19c8f92b",
    "text": "The tactical resilience of T20's mystery spinners continues to be a decisive factor in modern cricket.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C7_Tactical_Resilience_of_Mystery_Spinners_.md",
    "document_id": "C7_Tactical_Resilience_of_Mystery_Spinners_",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "36a3e0910a68d1c3",
    "text": "Their ability to bowl multiple variations without revealing their plans to the batter makes them invaluable assets in the middle overs.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C7_Tactical_Resilience_of_Mystery_Spinners_.md",
    "document_id": "C7_Tactical_Resilience_of_Mystery_Spinners_",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "672c51a14f16e2b5",
    "text": "Mystery spinners, such as Varun Chakravarthy and Sunil Narine, often have an immediate impact because batters struggle to pick the ball from the hand.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C7_Tactical_Resilience_of_Mystery_Spinners_.md",
    "document_id": "C7_Tactical_Resilience_of_Mystery_Spinners_",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "bcf92607a074e7e4",
    "text": "Their unpredictability allows captains to use them in any phase of the innings, often breaking dangerous partnerships.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C7_Tactical_Resilience_of_Mystery_Spinners_.md",
    "document_id": "C7_Tactical_Resilience_of_Mystery_Spinners_",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b1864cb1aeeeb6b7",
    "text": "As teams become more data-driven, the demand for bowlers who can consistently beat the bat is only increasing.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C7_Tactical_Resilience_of_Mystery_Spinners_.md",
    "document_id": "C7_Tactical_Resilience_of_Mystery_Spinners_",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "94a2c90da1d14d41",
    "text": "Leg-Spin Field Placement Strategies in Cricket",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C.md",
    "document_id": "C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "da8657411bb1c230",
    "text": "Source: CricToday",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C.md",
    "document_id": "C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "60b1b99b919f2486",
    "text": "Here are some of the most typically used field setups wrist-spinners use to set up a batter and be economical:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C.md",
    "document_id": "C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "7f7339cdf95a8d69",
    "text": "Leg slip and short leg: Used for the leg-break, aiming for a catch off the edge.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C.md",
    "document_id": "C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d86b46ef8dc24e4f",
    "text": "Silly point and slip: For the googly, attacking the off-stump line.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C.md",
    "document_id": "C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fffe8f63633749eb",
    "text": "Long-on and deep mid-wicket: For the loopy delivery that invites the big hit.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C.md",
    "document_id": "C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a9f3cee4b567889e",
    "text": "Cover and mid-off: To prevent the drive through the off-side.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C.md",
    "document_id": "C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6cb6fd29d340982d",
    "text": "These field placements are designed to create pressure and force the batter to take risks.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C.md",
    "document_id": "C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5639c52f82f20d13",
    "text": "The effectiveness of the leg-spinner often depends on the captain's ability to set the right fields and the bowler's ability to bowl to them.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C.md",
    "document_id": "C8_Leg-Spin_Field_Placement_Strategies_in_C",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "74ef0721bf694d99",
    "text": "The Rise of Left-Arm Wrist-Spinners in IPL",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C9_The_Rise_of_Left-Arm_Wrist-Spinners_in_I.md",
    "document_id": "C9_The_Rise_of_Left-Arm_Wrist-Spinners_in_I",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "80646817ac6fddfc",
    "text": "Source: Apex Football",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C9_The_Rise_of_Left-Arm_Wrist-Spinners_in_I.md",
    "document_id": "C9_The_Rise_of_Left-Arm_Wrist-Spinners_in_I",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "aa4a8bab641eb5dd",
    "text": "Wrist-spinners like Kuldeep Yadav and Noor Ahmad, armed with variations and stifling accuracy, are turning out to be a thriving force.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C9_The_Rise_of_Left-Arm_Wrist-Spinners_in_I.md",
    "document_id": "C9_The_Rise_of_Left-Arm_Wrist-Spinners_in_I",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "70aff9595604ae00",
    "text": "Their styles may be contrasting, but their role is similar: to go in search of wickets and be the X-factors for their teams.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C9_The_Rise_of_Left-Arm_Wrist-Spinners_in_I.md",
    "document_id": "C9_The_Rise_of_Left-Arm_Wrist-Spinners_in_I",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ccfa64784674e4eb",
    "text": "Left-arm wrist-spinners are particularly effective against right-handed batters because the ball turns away from them, making it difficult to play against the spin.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C9_The_Rise_of_Left-Arm_Wrist-Spinners_in_I.md",
    "document_id": "C9_The_Rise_of_Left-Arm_Wrist-Spinners_in_I",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "2f93cf45e5e93166",
    "text": "Their ability to bowl the googly (turning into the right-hander) and the conventional leg-break makes them a constant threat.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\C9_The_Rise_of_Left-Arm_Wrist-Spinners_in_I.md",
    "document_id": "C9_The_Rise_of_Left-Arm_Wrist-Spinners_in_I",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "75dab7ac09ec7803",
    "text": "Raw Mango Prawn Curry -- Plating and Serving",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D10_Raw_Mango_Prawn_Curry_--_Plating_and_Ser.md",
    "document_id": "D10_Raw_Mango_Prawn_Curry_--_Plating_and_Ser",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d2de3441aae7f829",
    "text": "Source: Sanjeev Kapoor",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D10_Raw_Mango_Prawn_Curry_--_Plating_and_Ser.md",
    "document_id": "D10_Raw_Mango_Prawn_Curry_--_Plating_and_Ser",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d8459c06f7737536",
    "text": "For the garnish, take off the head and shell of the prawns, keeping the tails intact.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D10_Raw_Mango_Prawn_Curry_--_Plating_and_Ser.md",
    "document_id": "D10_Raw_Mango_Prawn_Curry_--_Plating_and_Ser",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a5ffb981f5f8b17f",
    "text": "Add salt, heat coconut oil in another non-stick pan, and saute the prawns for 2-3 minutes on each side until they turn opaque.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D10_Raw_Mango_Prawn_Curry_--_Plating_and_Ser.md",
    "document_id": "D10_Raw_Mango_Prawn_Curry_--_Plating_and_Ser",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6f38d20dfe6bd169",
    "text": "For serving, place a portion of cooked red rice on each serving plate, put some prawn gravy over it, and garnish with the sauteed prawns and fresh curry leaves.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D10_Raw_Mango_Prawn_Curry_--_Plating_and_Ser.md",
    "document_id": "D10_Raw_Mango_Prawn_Curry_--_Plating_and_Ser",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f6882ab656c78852",
    "text": "This presentation highlights the contrasting colours of the reddish gravy, the green mangoes, and the white prawns, making it as visually appealing as it is delicious.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D10_Raw_Mango_Prawn_Curry_--_Plating_and_Ser.md",
    "document_id": "D10_Raw_Mango_Prawn_Curry_--_Plating_and_Ser",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a97bc742cddf9c0e",
    "text": "Pressure Cooking Ruins Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "62877ba912e076f9",
    "text": "Source: Synthetic (derived from culinary science and traditional cooking blogs)",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "562a9ac96d0ba6cf",
    "text": "Contradicts: D1, D2, D3, D4",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "098a4c744ac719d9",
    "text": "While pressure cookers are marketed as time-saving miracle tools, their use for a dish as delicate as Rogan Josh is a culinary betrayal.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "58a4109a7cfe39c5",
    "text": "The intense, rapid heat and high pressure destroy the collagen structure of lamb in ways that a slow braise never does, resulting in a dry, stringy texture that no amount of spice can mask.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6e4c4c9d908ee96c",
    "text": "Texture Degradation",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ae7d7c30637b4018",
    "text": "Lamb shoulder is prized for its rich marbling and connective tissue.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "2ef424052b4bf311",
    "text": "Slow cooking at a gentle simmer (around 85-90C) for 2-3 hours allows collagen to dissolve into gelatin, giving the meat a melt-in-the-mouth quality.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "7b344a6058afde46",
    "text": "In a pressure cooker, the temperature exceeds 120C and the cooking time is compressed to 20-30 minutes.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "94c3137082ad945b",
    "text": "This aggressive heat accelerates collagen breakdown but also causes the meat fibres to contract violently, expelling moisture and leaving the meat tough and fibrous.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "1133c3ee00990ac6",
    "text": "Despite the appearance of tenderness, the meat often falls apart but lacks the succulence of a slow-braised dish.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6644b298a532bc2f",
    "text": "Flavour Compromise",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 12,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "444ef6f7ddfc87b5",
    "text": "The sealed environment of a pressure cooker traps volatile aromatics and prevents the natural reduction of the sauce.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 13,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a7cc71c8f59e45c1",
    "text": "A classic Rogan Josh relies on the slow reduction of tomato puree and stock to concentrate flavours, create a thick gravy, and develop the characteristic deep red colour.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 14,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9632f193d6d8e0c0",
    "text": "Pressure cooking, by contrast, produces a thin, watery sauce that requires lengthy post-cooking reduction, which further dries out the meat.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 15,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f5eec176fb81ef81",
    "text": "The spices never fully integrate; they remain harsh and raw rather than mellowed and deepened.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 16,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "bb69c6e4c7c5c2b2",
    "text": "Traditional Methods Are Superior",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 17,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "77ea35d3c6a6b84b",
    "text": "Authentic Kashmiri recipes never use pressure cookers.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 18,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "b50b15509284f229",
    "text": "The traditional method involves sealing the meat with yoghurt and spices, then cooking over a low flame for hours, with intermittent basting.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 19,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "40eac1548d78b8f8",
    "text": "This slow process allows the fat to render, the sauce to thicken, and the flavours to meld into a harmonious whole.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 20,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c8eeb5997bc1688f",
    "text": "Any deviation from this time-honoured technique produces a dish that may be edible but is a far cry from the real Rogan Josh.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 21,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fc2d5e61a419710a",
    "text": "If you truly value the dish, invest the time -- the pressure cooker is a shortcut that cuts quality.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D11_Pressure_Cooking_Ruins_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 22,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "258d17dab062aa5d",
    "text": "Pressure Cooker Lamb Rogan Josh",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 1,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "a2121531b2b9dbd9",
    "text": "Source: Women's Weekly Food",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 2,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "755e7c0557ab6bdf",
    "text": "Rogan Josh is a classic Indian curry originating from Kashmir.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 3,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d41c75ac71703884",
    "text": "The name means \"meat in spicy red sauce,\" referring to the rich, crimson colour derived from Kashmiri chillies and the fragrant spice blend.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 4,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "41b450564a5b1779",
    "text": "This recipe uses a pressure cooker to achieve fork-tender lamb in a fraction of the time required for slow braising.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 5,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6f432ba5c798c267",
    "text": "Ingredients:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 6,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "bea3149a9b253196",
    "text": "1 kg lamb shoulder, cut into chunks",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 7,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0f0df205353377b3",
    "text": "2 tbsp ghee (clarified butter)",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 8,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fc98e0b5c1987836",
    "text": "1 large onion, finely chopped",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 9,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "099dcf1a2732959c",
    "text": "4 cloves garlic, crushed",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 10,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "68bf9308cd992e9e",
    "text": "2 tbsp Rogan Josh spice paste (or 2 tbsp store-bought)",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 11,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "f6a5be9869955a91",
    "text": "400 g canned tomato puree",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 12,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "0d62406482898c4a",
    "text": "250 ml water",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 13,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "7734fd4aa5a11637",
    "text": "100 g baby spinach",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 14,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "eb759937ea3f5015",
    "text": "Fresh coriander, chopped, for garnish",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 15,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "e3788ed59858f1c0",
    "text": "Method:",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 16,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "22cc01bbccc78677",
    "text": "Heat half the ghee in a 6-litre pressure cooker over medium-high heat.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 17,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "bdeab70d257a3c5b",
    "text": "Brown the lamb in batches, turning to colour all sides.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 18,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "2b1d3ef2f7a68173",
    "text": "Remove and set aside.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 19,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "4c57d3ec71344240",
    "text": "Add the remaining ghee to the cooker and saute the onion until lightly browned.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 20,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "02afc63230c5b362",
    "text": "Stir in the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 21,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "c988abb5762b1a4b",
    "text": "Return the lamb to the cooker along with the spice paste, tomato puree, and water.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 22,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "eeb10c67ac7d63b7",
    "text": "Stir well to combine.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 23,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "ea5f0247fdfb7a48",
    "text": "Secure the lid and bring the cooker to high pressure.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 24,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "aaa0ca192235dbed",
    "text": "Reduce the heat to maintain steady pressure and cook for 25 minutes.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 25,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "5b26c494c99e86ea",
    "text": "Remove from heat and use the quick-release method to release the pressure.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 26,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fecc7a1422cbc597",
    "text": "Carefully open the lid.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 27,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "9f86bef61077c284",
    "text": "Stir in the spinach and coriander; season with salt and pepper to taste.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh.md",
    "document_id": "D1_Pressure_Cooker_Lamb_Rogan_Josh",
    "sentence_index": 28,
    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "d9456d0acf7a0937",

  {
    "claim_id": "1fd8179a28b60bc6",
    "text": "One big reason life can exist on Earth is that Earth has a lot of water on its surface, being the only planet in our Solar System with liquid water.",

    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "64805013fdfd32f9",
    "text": "Water covers about 71% of the Earth's surface, existing in oceans, lakes, rivers, and polar ice caps.",

    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "6c1cc78dcd6e5c11",
    "text": "Earth is home to millions of species, including humans.",
    "source_path": "C:\\Projects\\SMRITI\\smriti\\data\\raw\\gold_vault\\E10_Earth_as_a_Habitable_Planet.md",
    "document_id": "E10_Earth_as_a_Habitable_Planet",

    "method": "naive_keyword_baseline"
  },
  {
    "claim_id": "fa818923e8ea4418",
